name: Vernon Robinson
subject: Democrat goes totally defensive in NC
body:
|
Peter \-- My radio campaign ads were the only ads running in North Carolina speaking directly to black voters about voting for Ted Budd, the local GOP candidate for Congress and the Republican team. I say were because they did not run this week because I only had enough money to run ads in Georgia to support Herschel Walker. What did run this week is Cheri Beasley's totally defensive radio ad attempting to defend her black voter base from my ads. My ads worked but unless something changes there won't be any more NC ads asking black voters for their votes. I'm asking you to give so I can put these very effective ads up next week. My ads were so good we didn't even mention Beasley by name. My Business Partner is Sandy Whitaker. Her big Democrat donor relative couldn't remember Beasley's name referring to her as the black women Judge. Sandy argued for not naming Beasley in the ads because if the mega donor could not remember her name, the brother or sister on the block would not know her name either. I agreed. Again, the ads are so effective in raising Budd's support and lowering black voter turnout that she felt she had to respond to ads that don't mention her. That's where you come in. By contributing to Black Americans Making America First today, you will do three things. **1\. You will help stop the Democrats from successfully running their spike the black vote strategy.** **2\. As black voters find out how radical Cheri Beasley is, many black voters will do one of two things, either vote for the Republicans or not vote at all.** **3\. You will continue to drive her on the defensive and if she is doing anything but running terrorist ads like "Vote Democratic or another black church will be bombed," she is off message.** We had five ads running in North Carolina on 5 radio stations but we only could run them until Oct 7 our fourth week of ads. These ads include saving black babies, school choice, the border, public safety and inflation. You can buy an ad to play this message to black voters. It costs $55 to buy an ad in Rocky Mount, $150 dollars in Fayetteville, $200 in Charlotte, $305 in Greensboro to $325 in Raleigh. We expect a large contributor to give $20,000, but the last $5000 will have to come from donors like you. We need you to contribute now because we have to pay for the ads by noon tomorrow. `Please give $0 ``or whatever you can.` | [](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nc_radio_ads&n=1 "Please donate Today") [Please donate Today](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nc_radio_ads&n=1)
---
`Remember you can give an unlimited amount as either an American citizen or corporation.`
Thank you for stepping up before and thank you in advance for helping do the hard work of freedom with your donation today.
Vernon Robinson, Co-Founder Black Americans Making America First (formally known as Black Americans to re-elect the President)
PS. Help get our hard hitting ads up for another week asking black voters for their support because you know that nobody has ever made a sale without asking for the business.

Peter,

**Tomorrow, Raphael Warnock and I will meet in Savannah for a U.S. Senate debate.**

I'm looking forward to giving voters an opportunity to see two very different visions for Georgia's future.

If you agree with open borders, ending cash bail, packing the Supreme Court with liberal justices, allowing taxpayer-funded abortions up to the moment of birth, or increasing government spending so inflation continues, Senator Warnock is your candidate. _**He has supported all these things while voting 96% of the time with Joe Biden.**_

If you believe in securing our border, supporting law enforcement, standing up for life, becoming energy independent, reducing spending to get inflation under control, and getting America back on the right track, I'm your candidate. _**I'll fight to defeat the disastrous Biden agenda in the U.S. Senate.**_

**It's really that simple, and I trust the voters will see those differences tomorrow.**

But you wouldn't know about many of these positions on issues if you watch the local news or read Georgia-based newspapers. They're far too busy chasing lies and distractions to report on the real issues that affect the families of Georgia and America.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Peter, I’m running for Congress to fight for working-class neighborhoods like the one that raised me in Endicott, Broome County. Not the special interests or Wall Street or corporate PACs – who have been corrupting our politics and selling us out for decades.

My family came to the Southern Tier over 100 years ago – working in the local factories where you didn’t need a college degree, just a strong work ethic and respect for your neighbors.

Over time growing up, I saw these good blue-collar jobs leave our town and head overseas where the labor was cheap, and the environment was exploited. It was clear that it was the result of greed in our economy and corruption in our politics.

**So I became an attorney to fight back and stand up for working-class neighborhoods like the one I grew up in.**

In my first case out of law school, I sued the Florida government (before it was popular), arguing that health care should be a civil right, no matter a family’s income.

In the Senate, I took on greedy cable companies looking to execute a merger that would raise costs for families.

In federal court, I argued in favor of ratifying the Equal Rights Amendment, and in the Supreme Court, I challenged the Trump Administration’s discriminatory Muslim Ban.

Now, I’m running for Congress to fight for my hometown and others across our district who have been sold out by career politicians like Marc Molinaro.

**The good news is that our message is resonating with voters across our 11 counties. But the bad news is that Molinaro’s Super PAC allies just added another $2 million to attack me with baseless lies and try and flip this seat red.**

clean_body: I’m running for Congress to fight for working-class neighborhoods like the one that raised me in Endicott, Broome County. | = | Peter, I’m going to get personal with you in this email today, and I hope you’ll read it from start to finish. = | = | = Peter, I’m running for Congress to fight for working-class neighborhoods like the one that raised me in Endicott, Broome County. Not the special interests or Wall Street or corporate PACs – who have been corrupting our politics and selling us out for decades. My family came to the Southern Tier over 100 years ago – working in the local factories where you didn’t need a college degree, just a strong work ethic and respect for your neighbors. Over time growing up, I saw these good blue-collar jobs leave our town and head overseas where the labor was cheap, and the environment was exploited. It was clear that it was the result of greed in our economy and corruption in our politics. So I became an attorney to fight back and stand up for working-class neighborhoods like the one I grew up in. In my first case out of law school, I sued the Florida government (before it was popular), arguing that health care should be a civil right, no matter a family’s income. In the Senate, I took on greedy cable companies looking to execute a merger that would raise costs for families. In federal court, I argued in favor of ratifying the Equal Rights Amendment, and in the Supreme Court, I challenged the Trump Administration’s discriminatory Muslim Ban. Now, I’m running for Congress to fight for my hometown and others across our district who have been sold out by career politicians like Marc Molinaro. The good news is that our message is resonating with voters across our 11 counties. Plus, we're ramping up digital advertising for races up and down the ballot to educate voters about the pro-environment candidates running this November who need their support.

**_Our organizing work is going to be critical to winning these races._** Time and time again, LCV Victory Fund has successfully defeated pro-polluter candidates in favor of climate champions by turning out voters by decisive margins. We can do it again with your help.

**We have a real shot at winning big on Election Day, but we really need your support today.** |

**Second OH-01 Debate: Landsman On Defense Over Repeated Tax Hikes That Increased the Burden on Hardworking Families While He Failed to Pay His Own Taxes** _Landsman’s Repeated Votes to Increase Taxes on City Council, Failure to Pay His Own Taxes, Support for Pelosi’s Inflation-Fueling Agenda in Washington, and Plan to Defund the Police Take Center Stage_ **For Immediate Release** Contact: John GomezEmail: [jgomez@chabotforcongress.com](mailto:jgomez@chabotforcongress.com) CINCINNATI – Congressman Steve Chabot’s campaign released the following statement following the second televised debate of the race for Congress in Ohio’s First Congressional District hosted by the Cincinnati USA Regional Chamber of Commerce, CET-TV and WVXU. “Greg Landsman learned his values working for Nancy Pelosi and that was evident in tonight’s debate as he doubled-down on his support for the extreme tax-and-spend agenda of his former boss that caused inflation to hit a 40-year-high and refused to answer for his record of repeatedly hiking taxes on families and small businesses on the Cincinnati City Council,” said Chabot campaign manager John Gomez. “Landsman was on the defensive throughout the night for his out-of-touch policies that include trying to defund the police amid record homicides in the City of Cincinnati and record of consistently increasing the burden on families.” “Landsman even incredulously claimed he ‘of course’ pays his taxes and it would be ‘absurd’ to suggest otherwise when he was slapped with a judgement by the State of Ohio earlier this year for unpaid taxes,” Gomez continued. “Landsman supports higher taxes for hardworking families and small businesses — but failed to pay his own taxes. He’s the wrong choice for families who care about the economy.” Get the facts on former Pelosi staffer Greg Landsman’s tax-hiking record [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=e4902a6ccee842369366a324ab30a920&_e=u7KjMzojVsdNRbmczMBjjubUuCenNp3_cfmoMtKvmihXKffqBT_FmpQnCJJgToBQM5RCsbullZ426vD0O8MG2xBXiQtNmIxmtblGdwCLCsBGTsK4fSIzgSVK7KopMDXaaU45ab1e8q3vTtxLkBRtLD3ik70QLDUOwUW_DzEa9VvxEpmsDXxoFIxt13ckQkupvT2r7KrkuQ7ltNpVZnHsqB5E5OngirFZMhYSOKbR2rhnNiHSUC2qnfxuTcWWYlDosOf9aZpWRekP696Gn2GFF5eHUlT44ISiwY1aVSD_6BzbuNgmy6tLiU8sFwgM-6vfmhxFXVulaCysm19qsAz31bsapu4Hf0mRMyEbAapEAVM%3D) and failure to pay his taxes [HERE](http://links.stevechabot.com/u/click?_t=8ab30ce69995407e81866ad352e10bc1&_m=e4902a6ccee842369366a324ab30a920&_e=u7KjMzojVsdNRbmczMBjjnwSgaHvkl6KDuyLNzXohkL65_C_XMuRNdt01eeVOC15XnFJPpQSg1ij66IfPiuiIWkIiwiECIEORmGBAN4UbWA3SqXmZyIBKr2j1pjaAhqpwh1cS48kqth5oC94CFYSr3i62vgF93fZsmLOGfz0kMk-nXtC-xn0dALYsFoWNnJ6mZpvReJh1YkXMCoVRvI1yC-3ERpguYUfbQjL_gzBMP4B7Az3iwzJWM1-12iD42vLai2CBURD1SSdLacH4NfFwA%3D%3D). Fellow American,

**Tomorrow, Raphael Warnock and I will meet in Savannah for a U.S. Senate debate.**

I'm looking forward to giving voters an opportunity to see two very different visions for Georgia's future.

If you agree with open borders, ending cash bail, packing the Supreme Court with liberal justices, allowing taxpayer-funded abortions up to the moment of birth, or increasing government spending so inflation continues, Senator Warnock is your candidate. _**He has supported all these things while voting 96% of the time with Joe Biden.**_

If you believe in securing our border, supporting law enforcement, standing up for life, becoming energy independent, reducing spending to get inflation under control, and getting America back on the right track, I'm your candidate. _**I'll fight to defeat the disastrous Biden agenda in the U.S. Senate.**_

body:

* * *
**I remember** my great-grandmother regularly bringing me to work with her as a kid. She was a community educator for Birmingham City Schools in Alabama.

**I remember** the seriousness in her work ethic and tone as she spoke frequently with families and students on the importance of education, being active in your community, and voting on issues that impact your community.

**I remember** sitting in my A.P. Government class in 2008, watching Black educators cry in pain and happiness as they heard Sam Cook's "A Change is Gonna Come" playing over the announcement of President Barack Obama being elected as the first Black president of the United States.

**I remember** citizenship training in 2013 as an AmeriCorps member studying the Alabama Constitution and seeing the disenfranchisement of Black Americans still highlighted in the constitution.

**I remember feeling so _emotional and powerless_ at a moment when I was committing myself to serve the state of Alabama.**
* * *
That moment of powerlessness reminded me of all of these moments. My memories of everything my great-grandmother taught me about community. The pain and happiness in the tears of Black educators at my high school feeling like their voice was finally heard after so many years – and that their vote mattered.

I was wondering, how did this happen? How are we, Black Americans, still voiceless in Alabama?

**[Gerrymandering impacts people of color, leaving them voiceless on issues that affect their communities. name: Office of U.S. Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: Fighting for Our Servicemembers, Veterans & Military Families
body:
|
---
Hi Neighbor,
Our servicemembers are the best among us. Our men and women in uniform, as well as their families, make tremendous sacrifices in defense of our freedoms, and it's our responsibility to ensure servicemembers, veterans, and their families have access to the resources they need to live safe, healthy lives--benefits they rightfully earned through their service. As the proud son of a veteran, and as a voice for Georgians in the Senate, I've fought since my first day in office to advocate for Georgia's servicemembers, veterans, and their families, and I'm so proud of what we've been able to accomplish for members of the military community across our state. **_Strengthening Critical Health Care Access & Benefits for Veterans:_** In August, I successfully pushed to pass the bipartisan _Honoring our PACT Act_ , and I'm proud that bill was signed into law. This important legislation will expand Veterans Affairs (VA) health care eligibility to 3.5 million veterans exposed to toxins from harmful burn pits. This is the most significant increase of benefits for America's veterans in over 30 years.
I am also thrilled that a bipartisan bill I introduced and championed with Republican Senator John Kennedy of Louisiana--the _Patient Advocate Tracker Act_ --was also signed into law just last month. This bill would increase transparency and accountability at the VA for veterans who report concerns by requiring the VA to create an electronic system for veterans to submit complaints, helping ensure our veterans are getting the care they need to live and thrive. And that's not all: last year, I successfully got a bill signed into law that will address disparities in access to service benefits that some veterans of color experience. I won't stop fighting to make sure our heroes have access to the health care and benefits they earned through their valiant service. **_Bolstering Affordable, Secure Military Housing:_** One in 10 Georgians is connected to the military, so when we invest in housing for our servicemembers and their families, we improve their quality of life while also strengthening our national security and keeping our local economies strong. That's why I'm leading the fight in the Senate to improve military housing, including working to restore the full basic housing allowance and update the formula so servicemembers are getting what they deserve; identify and address barriers to servicemember homeownership; and encourage private developers to build more housing for our military families near bases. **_Fighting for Our Military Families:_** Our nation is forever indebted to the brave men and women who laid it all on the line for our country, especially those who made the ultimate sacrifice. At the same time, their families--who have sacrificed immensely--also deserve our nation's steadfast support.
That's why I've championed efforts in the Senate to ensure the federal government is taking care of our military families. I've worked to ensure surviving spouses of deceased servicemembers can remarry without losing their benefits by introducing the bipartisan _Love Lives On Act_ with my Republican colleague Senator Jerry Moran of Kansas. I also worked with my Republican colleague Senator Cindy Hyde-Smith of Mississippi to introduce and unanimously pass a bipartisan resolution honoring Gold Star Families Remembrance Week, both in 2021 and 2022, to honor the loss and sacrifice of families whose pain will never go away. While there's still more work to do, I am deeply proud of my work in the Senate to support Georgia's servicemembers, veterans, and their loved ones. Know that I am committed to making sure Washington is keeping its promise to our veterans, and I look forward to working with my colleagues on both sides of the aisle to continue providing the resources and support our servicemembers deserve.

Until next time, neighbors, keep the faith and keep looking up.

Keep the faith, and keep looking up.
U.S. Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock

| This is official correspondence from the Office of Senator Reverend Raphael Warnock. If you have any questions, please contact our office [here](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenWarnock&crop=16511.11171644.6010001.14245539&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.warnock.senate.gov%2fcontact%2fcontact-form%2f&redir_log=51402161759365).

| | | | | _Peter,_ I’m Paul Begala. I’m a Democratic campaign strategist, former counselor to President Bill Clinton, and I’ve dedicated my career to electing Democrats up and down the ballot.

So today, I’m reaching out about one of the most important races this cycle: **We have the incredible opportunity to unseat one of the worst Republicans in the US House, Rep. Chabot, and replace him with a champion for families.**

Our slim House majority is on the line in just a few weeks, and I know Greg Landsman is the leader we need to retire Chabot and protect our democracy, fundamental rights, and so much more.

---
Friend, **Should schools be allowed to deliberately deceive parents and conduct gender transitions in secret?** Right now, woke judges are saying yes.

[**HELP US STOP THEM >>**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76340%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=bXpSvGQXvml9hEJD7tJ2iQ&sysid=1)
---
This summer, the Montgomery County Public School District released guidelines around gender identity, asserting that students have the “right” to keep their in-school gender identities private from their parents. Outraged parents sued the school district. And this month, a District Court judge ruled against the parents and threw out the lawsuit -- the first ruling of its kind. Similar lawsuits in other parts of the country are still in progress, but this landmark precedent is likely to lead the way.
[**We’re standing up against this wrongly decided verdict and expressing our support for parents’ rights**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76341%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cEOkt4I5bw0MvJsicCICGQ&sysid=1)**[.](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76342%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=87y8KA4TPtZV6752oVpP5g&sysid=1)[](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76343%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gXif%2fynALo7rkyYCNUr8YA&sysid=1) **School districts should NOT be allowed to conduct gender transitions on minors while intentionally hiding it from their parents and guardians.

Friend, the woke mob is coming after our courts.

Once they have control of our courts, the far Left intends to use that power to enforce their radical agenda without ever winning a single vote. The radical Left will use the courts to:
* Strip parents of their rights to raise their children as they see fit,
* Dismantle your 2nd amendment rights,
* _And attack any of your constitutional rights that get in the way of their agenda._

We know this is their goal because they have done it before, creating a right to legal abortion on demand with _Roe_ v. _Wade._ **But**** _Roe_****v.****_Wade_****teaches us something important: We CAN fight back against judicial activism.****And when we fight back, we can WIN.** **Will you fight back with us, Friend?**

name: Casey DeSantis
subject: Our Story
body:
| | | **[RUSH IN YOUR SUPPORT TO RE-ELECT GOVERNOR RON DESANTIS!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)**
---
| | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
Peter, Ron DeSantis is America's Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he's called home since his birth.__
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
| | Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney's Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America's veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet - parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I've watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children - so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. **[Rush in your support to help us keep fighting>>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r "Rush in your support to help us keep fighting >>>")**

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn't. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn't have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
---
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They're fighting to take away parents' rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron's opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He's made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians - including children - defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left's woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

_**[Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband's re-election? >>>](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r "Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for
my husband’s re-election? >>>")**_
---
[**SUPPORT GOVERNOR DESANTIS >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
[**KEEP FLORIDA FREE >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
[**RUSH IN YOUR SUPPORT >>>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)
---
Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis
---
[**MAKE A DONATION**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61621304:JSttMOVKN:m:1:3359512271:B8D8F3E8266D1A03501722B16C008083:r)

Eric Lynn for Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP24/1/93680/images/lynn-email-logo.png]
Friend, I am all too familiar with the cowardice of Florida Republicans like Anna Paulina Luna.

She's a self-proclaimed "pro-life extremist," and yet, she opposes gun reform legislation and background checks that could have saved my daughter Jaime's life.

Jaime was murdered at Marjory Stoneman Douglas High School in Parkland, Florida. And, since that day, I have not stopped fighting for gun reform that could have saved my daughter.

Just one week after, I confronted members of the Florida GOP at a town hall on gun safety. They couldn't even look at me and refused to work with Parkland survivors to make it more difficult for people to access weapons of war like the one that killed my Jaime. Since the Parkland shooting, members of Florida's GOP have continued to oppose several efforts to reduce gun violence.

Nothing will bring Jaime back, but helping changemakers like Eric Lynn – a leader who wants to end mass shootings and gun violence – gives me purpose.

That's why I'm personally asking today: Will you join me in supporting Eric Lynn by rushing a contribution of $5 or more now to help him defeat Anna Paulina Luna? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=ffb0b91f-c64b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&amount=5&refcode=221014_fg_jaime_l1]

From his service at the Department of Defense, Eric knows firsthand what weapons of war should be used for - to prevent terrorism overseas. He's been a strong supporter of gun reform here at home, and has pledged to support gun violence survivors once elected with your help.

I'm reaching out and asking you for financial support to keep this seat blue, but it's about more than that: It's about the people we can save. It's about creating a gun safety majority in Congress that will enact the policies needed to prevent families like mine from going through any more senseless tragedy.

This district is an open blue seat, and a recent poll showed that Eric is tied with his extremist opponent at 47%. FL-13 has the chance to stay blue with your help. She brought and wants to be like Marjorie Taylor Greene.

So please, can I count on you to donate $5 or more to help Eric Lynn keep FL-13 blue and make real progress on gun safety? Every dollar you give will build up the grassroots resources Eric needs to compete against massive amounts of GOP money. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=ffb0b91f-c64b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&amount=5&refcode=221014_fg_jaime_l2]

Democrats can only win with the grassroots support of people like you and me, which is why I want to thank you for doing your part to help Eric and gun violence victims everywhere.

Fred Guttenberg
Gun Violence Survivor

| Dear Friend,
My name is Rochelle Mercedes Garza and I’m the Democratic nominee for Texas Attorney General. I'm a 5th generation Texan, a new mom, and a civil rights attorney. I'm running to unseat criminally-indicted Ken Paxton and to be a Texas Attorney General _for the people_. I'd like to invite you to a virtual fundraiser on October 21, 2022 from 2:00 - 3:00 p.m.CT hosted by Sarah, Eva, America, Christy, Keli, Helen and Jordan, Katie, and Ngoc. You can RSVP here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/virtual10](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52584738/372749092/-2021802933?rmglavirtualmail1014=ea.6a324cd7-c74b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ms=ea.6a324cd7-c74b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YTMyNGNkNy1jNzRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=my8TlGh5gWZGz_3dEMDawy5C56M21m_e5q87arE0mM4=)** A recent DMN/UT Tyler poll released on Aug. 14. has **our campaign within two points of criminally indicted Ken Paxton at 34 to 32%**** –– _the tightest margin of any statewide race._** I’m beating Paxton among independent voters by 5 points, and more than half of those voters disapprove of his job performance. I’ve spent my career fighting for children, immigrants and families who too often find themselves the victims of the powerful. I took on Donald Trump, Ken Paxton, and Brett Kavanaugh when they tried to prevent an immigrant teen from exercising her right to choose – and I won. This work resulted in the “Garza Notice,” which requires detained teens be notified of their right to abortion without retaliation and obstruction by the federal government. Ken Paxton is the weakest and most unpopular incumbent Attorney General in the country with significant legal troubles that will land him in jail if convicted. On top of being indicted more than seven years ago on securities fraud, he is also under FBI investigation for bribery. In 2018, Paxton won with less than 300,000 votes –– the slimmest margin of victory of any statewide Republican in Texas. Since then, Texas has added nearly 2 million voters to the rolls, which only benefits our campaign.
As Election Day nears, we're working hard to reach every donor. Every dollar we raise goes to making sure our ads stay on tv as long as possible. Truly, every contribution matters a lot!
I want to thank **Sarah, Eva, America, Christy, Keli, Helen and Jordan, and Ngoc **for hosting this event and supporting the campaign. I hope you can join us!

subject: Can you see the warning signs?
body:
[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7ae2747c5c09463fae5dae7b029c7863&_e=GPMqCrGYqy03SuI_u-isuTllILmjBezzRgAOaTUgmUCVLV8k3cME_GoLqSBCpNNnc2EbORTwQ5lOAiyOLn7Mb6HknnVFTj9WawZWFFIKn-5t5gSNAbxI-7qL6VCsblJsXZwci-Tx88XSTKGqqM5crq5smvdiFP10SVf_HajqH_45RIS8MdqXvwUpouq9QqSJpbjZzJcBs2AIA8ukKOXZqVd0t1_o91--oM90WZj8JHjyZuqjWlMybI_gKVkwhgqo3BZEyuQhI5bv1nBzNoanuQ%3D%3D)
Hello Friend,

I've seen signs of socialism taking hold here in America. Have you seen them too?

Some people may excuse it as _"no big deal"_ or say, _"it can't happen here."_

In Venezuela they told us the same and even that _"we could never become like Cuba"._

Well, we did. As much as I hate to be the bearer of bad news, I need to tell you that it can happen here and it will if you let it. **I've experienced it first-hand!**

Venezuela used to be a democratic and free country. I came from a middle-class family, and we did well for ourselves.

**But then the Socialists were _elected_ into power, and they drove the country into extreme poverty. **

Inspired by the ruin of Venezuela, I traveled to America to study economics and became a big advocate for free markets and capitalism.

**I founded the Dissent Project, Friend, to send survivors of socialism to high schools and teach students about this dangerous ideology before colleges brainwash them.**

[_**That’s why I set a goal to raise $25,000 this month so that the Dissident Project can speak at schools across the country. Can you send a gift of $10, $35, $50, or any amount? Click here to donate >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7ae2747c5c09463fae5dae7b029c7863&_e=GPMqCrGYqy03SuI_u-isuTllILmjBezzRgAOaTUgmUCVLV8k3cME_GoLqSBCpNNnc2EbORTwQ5lOAiyOLn7Mb6HknnVFTj9WawZWFFIKn-6P33Dr0PHsO_2505DsfMUFdisVAptmKOlrnIaGLIhoTcSTqc_pphmrffcconmwkBRNmJJ9qpYr_gRA-ISx5pyjf89OR_XH0EV6xZ92qYCsPJlK8_sr2vk4gm9YhLKgkwG-tGdctjqFv1jhmtoDR9K8zb91Aes80aa3CZdKHDg0WQ%3D%3D)

One thing I see in America that reminds me of Venezuela is inflation. Hyperinflation destroyed the economy in Venezuela.

I remember one day when I wanted to see a movie. _I couldn't fit enough cash in my pocket_ just to pay for a ticket.

Then there were power outages across the country. You never knew when they were going to hit or for how long. One time, my grandmother and I got stuck in the elevator for hours.

**These are just a couple of the experiences I’ve had with the horrors of socialism**. And with your support, I can share these experiences with high school students across the country.

Thankfully, supporting a Dissident Project speaker doesn’t take a backpack full of money.

[_** Friend, can you send a generous gift today? Even a donation of $10, $35, or even $50 makes a big difference. Click here to support the Dissident Project >>>**_](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7ae2747c5c09463fae5dae7b029c7863&_e=GPMqCrGYqy03SuI_u-isuTllILmjBezzRgAOaTUgmUCVLV8k3cME_GoLqSBCpNNnc2EbORTwQ5lOAiyOLn7Mb6HknnVFTj9WawZWFFIKn-7BqUhLQAMfKOAg5kodSwL-2mjURSrDJ6_gxoph2d8t_VG7NAdFv-jz61Oqw2stU1NLPg42kB3THtHFOP0zvn0ee0A5XwHuD8F36dWqe6NT6-cNSR-MSYwiZAr1AnojuIamnffITBiiWDFQycdut9ojTvNufG2Wf39c4H2oY4YVNQ%3D%3D)

**We’ve already reached 2,000 students with the first talks for our Dissident Project. **

[](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=7ae2747c5c09463fae5dae7b029c7863&_e=GPMqCrGYqy03SuI_u-isuTllILmjBezzRgAOaTUgmUCVLV8k3cME_GoLqSBCpNNnc2EbORTwQ5lOAiyOLn7Mb6HknnVFTj9WawZWFFIKn-4VRObATX31oDPh6PJKZ1GQxSn7ywb6biqPNnYtSMdOGUvvLMZ9vZSyjCAo3-9rhkCOwJ_frRFiBRJsvT1jqBiC2qKCb0eg8cSCHSop1t4-Sy_8-hjX0F4qi-_YQHAtuLsZNrX322NIsj--Yonk8Co01hlKEK5OmSHE7ppItajREg%3D%3D)

I shared my experience of fleeing Venezuela's socialist regime and the importance of preserving the liberties we enjoy in the United States.

Afterward, students lined up to take photos, and teachers gave me the opportunity to speak to their smaller classrooms as well.

**I even met a student from Venezuela with a similar story which sparked a much-needed conversation about the value of freedom among their classmates.**

The Dissident Project reminds students that socialism isn’t a thing of the past — I lived through it.

We have 25 additional talks and counting scheduled for this school year alone. Your support helps us provide these talks at no cost to schools.

Please support the Dissident Project today by clicking below and help us reach our goal of raising $25,000 this month.

clean_body: Hello Friend, I've seen signs of socialism taking hold here in America. Have you seen them too? Some people may excuse it as "no big deal" or say, "it can't happen here." In Venezuela they told us the same and even that "we could never become like Cuba". Well, we did. As much as I hate to be the bearer of bad news, I need to tell you that it can happen here and it will if you let it. I've experienced it first-hand! Venezuela used to be a democratic and free country. I came from a middle-class family, and we did well for ourselves. But then the Socialists were elected into power, and they drove the country into extreme poverty. Inspired by the ruin of Venezuela, I traveled to America to study economics and became a big advocate for free markets and capitalism. I founded the Dissent Project, Friend, to send survivors of socialism to high schools and teach students about this dangerous ideology before colleges brainwash them. One thing I see in America that reminds me of Venezuela is inflation. Hyperinflation destroyed the economy in Venezuela. I remember one day when I wanted to see a movie. I couldn't fit enough cash in my pocket just to pay for a ticket. Then there were power outages across the country. You never knew when they were going to hit or for how long. One time, my grandmother and I got stuck in the elevator for hours. These are just a couple of the experiences I’ve had with the horrors of socialism. And with your support, I can share these experiences with high school students across the country. Thankfully, supporting a Dissident Project speaker doesn’t take a backpack full of money. We’ve already reached 2,000 students with the first talks for our Dissident Project. I shared my experience of fleeing Venezuela's socialist regime and the importance of preserving the liberties we enjoy in the United States. Afterward, students lined up to take photos, and teachers gave me the opportunity to speak to their smaller classrooms as well. I even met a student from Venezuela with a similar story which sparked a much-needed conversation about the value of freedom among their classmates. The Dissident Project reminds students that socialism isn’t a thing of the past — I lived through it. We have 25 additional talks and counting scheduled for this school year alone. Your support helps us provide these talks at no cost to schools. Please support the Dissident Project today by clicking below and help us reach our goal of raising $25,000 this month. | FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE FRIDAY, OCTOBER 14
CITIZENS FOR A GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES HALF-MILLION DOLLAR GOTV CAMPAIGN
(ATLANTA) - Today, Citizens for a Greater Georgia launched a half-million dollar get-out-the-vote campaign for Republican State Senate candidates in target districts across the state. The campaign represents one of the most significant investments in local legislative races, and includes digital ads, text messages and direct mail. Combined with the committee's ongoing canvassing operation, which has contacted over 550,000 Georgians on their doorsteps or by phone, the outreach campaign is designed to protect incumbent state senate seats - and win new seats - to preserve and grow the Republican State Senate Majority.
The target districts for the outreach campaign are as follows:

name: Chrissy Houlahan
subject: My first race was just the beginning
body:
Just like our first race, this one is also an uphill battle
| | |
---
**Derek, 2018 was just the beginning. **
Ever since you elected me as the first woman ever to represent Pennsylvania's 6th Congressional District, I’ve been fighting to deliver on our bold vision for the future: protecting reproductive freedom, great jobs, affordable health care for all, equal opportunity for everyone to thrive, and more! I don't plan to slow down either and here's why:
After my father came to the United States as a refugee fleeing war-torn Poland, he was given the opportunity to attend Columbia College and later had the honor to serve in the Navy. Following in my father's footsteps, I went to Stanford and MIT and served in the Air Force. I knew then what I know now: I wanted to give back to my community and the country that has given me and my whole family so much.

As an entrepreneur, after starting and leading several companies, this spirit of service led me to become the founding COO of B-Labs, so I could help small businesses grow in a sustainable, community-enriching manner. Soon thereafter, I worked as a chemistry teacher in North Philadelphia as a Teach for America Corps member.
Then, after President Trump was elected in 2016, I saw how nervous my family was about the future of our country. From my daughters to my father, we were horrified about what was to come. That's when I decided to run for Congress, to make life better for our Commonwealth, and for you.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52588557/372764386/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk712-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTY3Yzg2MC1jZDRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8oI2vktBZT7TQE3Rss5KWRkCxbDflMbKHWBPQHTqWbk=)
My experiences have helped shape my political vision, and I've never stopped fighting for PA-06. But my opponent and his allies are doing everything they can to block our mission of progress – and now House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy has made our district a top target in this year's midterm elections.
Just like our first race, this one is also an uphill battle. But we proved that if we stand together, we can make a better future for everyone in PA-06. In many ways, our work has only just begun. [**Please, Derek, can you donate $5 so we can power our movement to victory and keep this seat and the House blue?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52588558/372764388/685235109?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk712-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NDkxMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOTY3Yzg2MC1jZDRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8oI2vktBZT7TQE3Rss5KWRkCxbDflMbKHWBPQHTqWbk=)
Thank you for your support. There's work to be done.

Chrissy

| | | | | Peter, I'm going to ask you to join me in helping Rachel Baker defeat Jenn Giroux, in what is Ohio's most important state legislative race--perhaps one of the most important in the country. This is why I’m writing you 25 days before the election: **_Four years ago, my daughter Jaime was murdered with an assault weapon in the Parkland massacre. Ever since, Republicans like Jenn Giroux have not only done almost nothing to solve a problem, but, in fact, they've passed legislation in Ohio and other states to allow any criminal or terrorist to carry concealed weapons of war in our streets, by eliminating background checks._** We've seen the results in Uvalde, Buffalo, Highland Park, and in 2019, the Oregon, District of Dayton, Ohio, when nine people out for a fun night on the town were murdered, and 17 others sent to local hospitals with their lives never to be the same. [**This is about saving lives: Will you donate $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to elect Rachel Baker, defeat Jenn Giroux and put us closer to expanding gun safety and abortion rights in Ohio and nationally?**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T10d78653-c445-4af9-bcc9-7ab98964b9fb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **After the awful Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v Wade, Giroux also came out against abortion in all cases--making the ridiculous claim that women never have to choose between their lives and having an abortion. Giroux's combination of extremism and ignorance are both astounding and dangerous. **

It is also key to getting closer to taking back the state house under the newer lines prescribed by a constitutional amendment to the state constitution. So I'm asking for your help, friend. Jenn Giroux is being supported by the worst right-wing mega-donors and interests spending a ton of money on her behalf. If we can help Rachel Baker overcome the right-wing money and win this race, we'll also helping turn out voters to help elect Whaley, and Democrats Greg Landsman in a swing House seat and Tim Ryan as our U.S. Senator. **_I've often said I consider Ohio a second home, as much of my family lives in the Cincinnati area. [**Congressman Brian Mast (R-FL) Endorses James Judge for Congress**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=ba04659a94&e=00028e5542)
_A sitting Florida Congressman and decorated war veteran has officially endorsed James Judge in his bid to unseat Rep. Kathy Castor (D-FL)._ TAMPA, Fla. – Rep. Brian Mast, a Republican U.S. Congressman from Florida, has endorsed James Judge, the Republican nominee in Florida’s 14th Congressional District, as he takes on incumbent Democrat Rep. Kathy Castor (D-FL).“James is a fellow veteran who has answered the call to continue his service, and I’m happy to support him in his campaign for Florida’s 14th Congressional District,” said Mast. “Democrats in D.C. have made life much more difficult over the past two years with skyrocketing inflation and violent crime rates soaring under their failed policies. James wants to get the federal government out of the way so Americans can thrive, and that’s exactly the type of person we need more of in Congress.”Mast is in his third term as the congressman in Florida’s 18th Congressional District.“I’m proud and grateful to have Congressman Mast’s endorsement as we approach the general election,” said Judge. “He is a tireless leader for the people of Florida and a champion of American values in Washington. I look forward to serving alongside him in Congress.”Judge recently won a straw poll conducted by the Riverview Chamber of Commerce by a margin of nearly five points over his incumbent Democrat opponent Kathy Castor.In addition to Mast’s endorsement, Judge has received endorsements from Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, the Community Patriots Tampa, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

subject: Our Story
body:
| | | [](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=a39ab86df7&e=fdefed58de)
---
Peter,Ron DeSantis is America’s Governor.

He leads with courage, conviction, and principle on behalf of Floridians.

He is dedicated to the people of Florida and proudly represents the state he’s called home since his birth.
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=b8b30c241a&e=fdefed58de)
Ron worked and paid his way through college, where he played baseball and served as the team captain, and graduated with a B.S. in History.

[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=f58ab55268&e=fdefed58de)
After graduating from Yale, Ron attended Harvard Law School where he volunteered to serve the U.S. Navy. During his tenure on active-duty, Ron deployed to Iraq as an adviser to a U.S. Navy SEAL commander. Attached to SEAL Team 1, Ron was awarded the Bronze Star for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=41737c598a&e=fdefed58de)
I met Ron while he was on active duty stationed at Mayport Naval Base in Northeast Florida.

While on his active-duty, Ron was appointed to the U.S. Attorney’s Office and served as a federal prosecutor, where he led efforts to convict child predators.

Ron and I were married in 2009 and lived in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=78c2fbc2dc&e=fdefed58de)
Continuing his call to serve, Ron ran for U.S. Congress. Winning a seven-way primary with 38.8% of the vote, Ron won his first of three terms in Congress.

While in office, Ron advocated for congressional term limits and a balanced budget amendment. He also spearheaded oversight efforts to expose malfeasance in the IRS and in agencies involved in abusing their authority during the manufacturing of the Russia collusion conspiracy theory.

Ron was also a leading champion for America’s veterans and helped enact reforms to the VA and place an emphasis on mental health.

In 2016, Ron and I embarked on our most important role yet – parenthood. From the moment she was born, our blessing, Madison, forever changed our lives.
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=a2c6677714&e=fdefed58de)
Shortly after she was born, Ron launched his campaign for Governor. 2018 was one of the most eventful years of our lives as Ron was elected the 46th Governor of Florida and we welcomed our son Mason to the world.

In 2020, we became a party of five with the birth of our daughter Mamie. She was the first baby born to a sitting Governor in more than 50 years.

I’ve watched Ron excel as a Navy JAG officer, federal prosecutor, U.S. Congressman, and now Governor, but his role as a father to our three little ones has by far been the most rewarding.
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d38fd44b9c&e=fdefed58de)
As a father, he understood the risks of keeping kids locked out of the classroom and the ramifications of force-masking our children – so as Governor, he led efforts to pass legislation to prohibit mandates and empower parents. [**Rush in your support to help us keep fighting >>>**](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=88b453947f&e=fdefed58de)

He foresaw the detrimental effects of shuttering businesses and as a result, he rejected draconian lockdowns and kept the state of Florida open for business.

As a federal prosecutor, Ron understood the importance of upholding the rule of law and supporting our brave men and women in law enforcement. As the leader of our state, Ron rejected calls from the Left to defund the police while making it known that Florida is a law-and-order state.

But if you want to know who Ron DeSantis really is, when I was diagnosed with cancer and I was facing the battle for my life, he was the dad who took care of my children when I couldn’t. He was there to pick me off of the ground when I literally could not stand. He was there to fight for me when I didn’t have the strength to fight for myself. **That is who Ron DeSantis is.**
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=d0fb970a93&e=fdefed58de)
He accomplished a lot over the past three and a half years, but our fight has only just begun. Extreme Leftists around the nation are turning once beautiful cities into woke wastelands.

Blue states are giving more consideration to dangerous criminals than their own citizens. They’re fighting to take away parents’ rights in the classroom and working to advance a curriculum that indoctrinates our youngest children.

Ron’s opponent has voted in support of the Biden Regime 100% of the time in Congress. He’s made known his plans to impose vaccine mandates on Floridians – including children – defund the police, and indoctrinate our children with the Left’s woke ideologies.

I can tell you, Ron will never stop fighting, but he needs your help to stay in the fight.

_[**Will you join us in the fight today by sending your support for my husband’s re-election? >>>**](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=41866a515b&e=fdefed58de)_
[](https://breakingconservativedaily.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=80ed0c6fa3&e=fdefed58de)
Sincerely,
Casey DeSantis

| Aadland Condemns Pettersen For Push To Defund Border Enforcement Agencies, Grant Mass Amnesty
---
|
---
---
| Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, released a statement condemning his opponent, State Senator Brittany Pettersen, on her extreme stance regarding border security and illegal immigration. In a [letter](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001h_TYg-5jgAyAL5z_oHmgbyg8u9gX_mKmYQSAs7bSl8XX-fJKGip5yyxFkxMTO73mO47vsA9AwlGTK0B2QbyjpNRJXh0qCMysVpOG-ZetPN754PxXG_uGr8u5aS_-BQO2W5Y5W0aL90QaGLRAtW_2Lg9a9_W1F1ohQW53qbuGVCQGn7mxbnIEd46kNn-savk55ZkWcgZvgahoys4GjR2lIQRo26yNxAybv_zM5wF2qlpqdDzo-hj4PcyUCd36eFBuRsu5tQls5WGplNMrHv7hl4T4niB5nGtD&c=R0lSOOEMUsXXh60sXU-9cj-X8qfCO5VDn3FxvChZ0lQPaDFYRETlYQ==&ch=28F1KP649VJXVTRLos5zVicZzelgoDTEV35Me_Ow80Mb3m_Oj3Jjag==) to President Biden in September of 2021, Pettersen joined lawmakers nationwide urging the president to defund all border enforcement agencies and to grant mass amnesty to millions of illegal immigrants.
---
"I am shocked and appalled that such a naked attempt aimed at ending America's protection of its borders and immigration law would come from someone who took an oath to support and defend the Constitution," stated Aadland. "If heeded, this request would destroy the integrity of U.S. borders, jeopardize our national security and cause an influx of illegal immigrants on a massive scale. The southern border is already an unmitigated humanitarian crisis and national security crisis. With Chinese fentanyl streaming across the border unchecked, killing our citizens, this proposal is as preposterous as my opponent's efforts to reduce the penalties for fentanyl distribution. "My opponent has proven, in this smoking gun of a letter, that she is dangerous to our fellow citizens, does not believe in the rule of law, and is hellbent on tearing down our laws. We cannot afford another radical in Washington."

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York or shady philanthropists backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.

When Donald Trump was elected, I submitted my request to retire from the U.S. Navy after nearly 4 decades of military service. I never expected I’d one day run for office, but I felt called to continue to serve in whatever way was most meaningful.
People told me to prepare myself – to prepare my family – for what lay ahead. They warned me of the nasty attacks, that politics is a ‘blood sport.’ **I never thought a Super PAC would run over a million dollars in TV ads attacking me for serving in the U.S. Navy, but that’s exactly what happened.**
They tried to say that because my military service took me and my family from state-to-state, from country-to-country, that I somehow wasn’t an Iowan anymore. They pretended my upbringing in rural, northwest Iowa never happened. They ignored the sacrifices that my wife, my kids, and my family made in my service.
**And worst of all, they attacked and denigrated every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, and sometimes spend holidays thousands of miles away from each other.**
Now, I’m taking on an even greater challenge. And in my campaign to defeat Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, things have gotten even nastier, because control of the Senate hinges on our race and whether or not we can turn Iowa blue.
**In order to fight back, we need to raise $350,000 before our FINAL mid-month deadline at midnight tonight, but right now, we’re still falling very short. Dan Cox wins the confidence of 73% of Maryland voters who watched the debate as the one they trust to reduce our crime problem! *

*Fox45 live-poll October 12, 2022.
| Friends,

I obtained confessions from Wes Moore this week you need to know about. At our debate he stated:
* _Vaccine and health mandates_ ("jabs for jobs" and social involvement): I said Wes Moore was for the vaccine passport and COVID mandates taking possession of our very bodies. Wes Moore defended his experimental vaccine "passport" and said "a Moore-Miller administration will...follow the CDC and professionals when we make the decisions." I will end all such mandates and let the people make their own decisions. His goal? - Take over our farms and waterman businesses. (33 minute mark).

* _Reparations_ (redistribution of wealth for "reparative" punitive action to end racial inequities): The panelist asked if we were for reparations, I said no, only for the COVID lockdowns but not for the divisive taking from one person or business _over the color of their skin_. Wes Moore said "we've got to take this state in a ...meaningful direction, we've got to take meaningful action, reparative action, to address the racial wealth inequities in our society." (13:00 mark; 15:30 mark for his admission).

* _Crime and Police_ : I said we will restore law and order again and that Moore will defund the police as he works with Open Society which sought to defund the police in my Judiciary Committee. Wes Moore said he will "ensure people feel safe in their own skin" and refused to deny his [Salon.com](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=dcc2ab8a67&e=5bb5efcda7) statements to defund the police other than to lie and say "that's not true". My response - google it, Salon.com. He will export Baltimore City murders, robberies and rapes statewide. (10:10; 19:30 and 43:25 mark).

* _Abortion_ (the panel included two questions on this topic): Wes Moore admitted he will support a Constitutional Amendment for abortion on demand up through the Third Trimester and would not deny that he would even sign infanticide bills. This is extreme and unsupported by the majority in Maryland (31:20 mark).

* _Parental Rights & Gender indoctrination/sex change counseling for kids behind parents' backs_: I said "we cannot protect our kids when we exclude parents, like my opponent will do." Wes Moore said "I trust my kids' educators...Educator participation is not indoctrination." (45:30; 48:20 and 48:48 marks). This is the same position as Terry McAuliff in VA when he said "teachers should be trusted to teach, parents should not interfere...".

* _Ban on Gasoline Cars_ : Dan Cox will expand and build our roads with an all-of-the-above approach. Wes Moore will ban gas cars, not expand our roads, but promised to build mass transit. He said "Every single transportation project I will decide through three 'lens': 1) Equity (racial, etc. - "making sure we approve of who is building and benefiting from the project", e.g., racial contract quotas; shift away from roads to mass transit); 2) Environmental - [non-fossil fuel transportation favored, or, roads not favored]; 3) Local [approval/vetos of projects]." (51:20 mark)... "I will add electrification to the electric grid to handle electric cars." He did not deny his opponent sponsored the bill to tie us to banning gasoline cars by 2035 nor did he deny that he supports such action.

* _Eastern Shore_ : My wife's family is from the Shore and I have a plan to protect the Bay and our farmers. Wes Moore stated there is a climate emergency and that "literally a quarter of the Eastern Shore...will be flooded in its businesses and homes in the next 50 years...". This is ludicrous and something climate activists have been falsely alleging for the last 50 years. (52:57 mark).

I am running hard to the finish line just 25 days away with 18+ hour days campaigning as is our whole team. We need a final push for media advertising. Would you kindly help us with your generous donation. Or sign up to volunteer today. Thank you.

For Your Freedom,

| | | Friend,

After this election, Senate seats in both Georgia and Florida are in danger of being controlled by Democrats for the next six years. I'm running to unseat a Democrat incumbent, and Senator Marco Rubio is fending off a Democrat opponent who has outraised him TWO TO ONE!

I always knew Democrats loved to spend money, but this is concerning. In order for Republicans to take back the Senate, Marco Rubio must DEFEND his seat in Florida while we FLIP Georgia.
---

Retaking the Senate is the best hope we have to reverse some of the damage from Biden's litany of disasters. And that becomes more difficult if we don't hold on to Marco's seat.

I can't stress enough the importance of re-electing a conservative leader like Marco. **America cannot afford two more years of Democrat control of the Senate, House, and the White House.**

---
I got off the sidelines and decided to run for the U.S. Senate because our country is going down the wrong track. President Biden's record includes the heart-wrenching disaster in Afghanistan, MASSIVE spending in Washington that caused our record inflation, and an open border that has caused a national security crisis.

Please join me in standing with Marco Rubio and fighting back against the far-Left!

Herschel Walker

I'm starting to get nervous because I am one of the most vulnerable Republicans up for re-election this November and Pelosi knows that if the Dems defeat me, they will have full access to pass their liberal agenda.

**The Filibuster will be abolished.

Speech will be censored.**

**And conservatives will be silenced.**

Hey it's Marco and I just checked my watch - **we 're running out of time.**

I just don't know what to do. I keep asking myself, _" Is it even worth reaching out to them again?"_

I know you get a lot of these, and I know it can be overwhelming looking at all the requests. But if you respond to just 1 today, please, make it this one. I am being outraised 3 to 1, and polls are tied. They're saying this may be my closest race yet. **They 're saying I'm in the fight of my life.**

Peter, This is an important email that explains why our election work, and your support, is so critical. Please check it out. We wanted to re-introduce you to one of our "Spotlight Candidates," who are candidates in some of the toughest races around the country and in a tough fight to keep their seat in Congress, or a candidate trying to defeat a current Republican standing in the way of gun reform in Washington. Thanks to generous supporters like you, we are able to support these candidates in their fight and we need your further support to keep up the fight to help these candidates win. In 2018 and 2020, you helped us elect Elaine Luria to Congress, in hotly contested races each year, defeating an NRA backed Republican both times. This election, she is fighting to continue representing Virginia's 2nd District. **Election analysts have called this one of the tightest congressional races in the entire COUNTRY with polling having the race at a 50/50 split. The outcome of her race could determine whether Republicans retake control of the House of Representatives. If that happens, all progress on critical issues like gun reform will move backwards.** [_**Can you rush a donation to Pride Fund today to help us prevent that from happening? # All fired up! Just off the debate stage this week.
Dan Cox wins the confidence of 73% of Maryland voters who watched the debate as the one they trust to reduce our crime problem! *

*Fox45 live-poll October 12, 2022.

Dan Cox wins the confidence of 73% of Maryland voters who watched the debate as the one they trust to reduce our crime problem! *

*Fox45 live-poll October 12, 2022.
| Friends,

I obtained confessions from Wes Moore this week you need to know about. At our debate he stated:
* _Vaccine and health mandates_ ("jabs for jobs" and social involvement): I said Wes Moore was for the vaccine passport and COVID mandates taking possession of our very bodies. Wes Moore defended his experimental vaccine "passport" and said "a Moore-Miller administration will...follow the CDC and professionals when we make the decisions." I will end all such mandates and let the people make their own decisions. His goal? - Take over our farms and waterman businesses. (33 minute mark).

* _Reparations_ (redistribution of wealth for "reparative" punitive action to end racial inequities): The panelist asked if we were for reparations, I said no, only for the COVID lockdowns but not for the divisive taking from one person or business _over the color of their skin_. Wes Moore said "we've got to take this state in a ...meaningful direction, we've got to take meaningful action, reparative action, to address the racial wealth inequities in our society." (13:00 mark; 15:30 mark for his admission).

* _Crime and Police_ : I said we will restore law and order again and that Moore will defund the police as he works with Open Society which sought to defund the police in my Judiciary Committee. Wes Moore said he will "ensure people feel safe in their own skin" and refused to deny his [Salon.com](https://coxforfreedom.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=866897dcd900340c866a1068a&id=7794087dd9&e=5bb5efcda7) statements to defund the police other than to lie and say "that's not true". My response - google it, Salon.com. He will export Baltimore City murders, robberies and rapes statewide. (10:10; 19:30 and 43:25 mark).

* _Abortion_ (the panel included two questions on this topic): Wes Moore admitted he will support a Constitutional Amendment for abortion on demand up through the Third Trimester and would not deny that he would even sign infanticide bills. This is extreme and unsupported by the majority in Maryland (31:20 mark).

* _Parental Rights & Gender indoctrination/sex change counseling for kids behind parents' backs_: I said "we cannot protect our kids when we exclude parents, like my opponent will do." Wes Moore said "I trust my kids' educators...Educator participation is not indoctrination." (45:30; 48:20 and 48:48 marks). This is the same position as Terry McAuliff in VA when he said "teachers should be trusted to teach, parents should not interfere...".

* _Ban on Gasoline Cars_ : Dan Cox will expand and build our roads with an all-of-the-above approach. Wes Moore will ban gas cars, not expand our roads, but promised to build mass transit. He said "Every single transportation project I will decide through three 'lens': 1) Equity (racial, etc. - "making sure we approve of who is building and benefiting from the project", e.g., racial contract quotas; shift away from roads to mass transit); 2) Environmental - [non-fossil fuel transportation favored, or, roads not favored]; 3) Local [approval/vetos of projects]." (51:20 mark)... "I will add electrification to the electric grid to handle electric cars." He did not deny his running mate Aruna Miller sponsored the bill to tie MD to banning gasoline cars by 2035 nor did he deny that he supports such action.

* _Eastern Shore_ : My wife's family is from the Shore and I have a plan to protect the Bay and our farmers. Wes Moore stated there is a climate emergency and that "literally a quarter of the Eastern Shore...will be flooded in its businesses and homes in the next 50 years...". This is ludicrous and something climate activists have been falsely alleging for the last 50 years. (52:57 mark).

I am running hard to the finish line just 25 days away with 18+ hour days campaigning as is our whole team. We need a final push for media advertising. Would you kindly help us with your generous donation. Or sign up to volunteer today. Thank you.

For Your Freedom,

* **_Paul Junge is using his million-dollar trust fund to try and buy a seat in Congress._** He has already contributed over $1.25 million of his own money to try and buy this congressional seat, despite not owning a home in mid-Michigan. He’s a multi-millionaire living off his family’s trust fund, who is out of touch with the needs of working families.

* **_Paul Junge is too extreme for mid-Michigan._** He supports an abortion ban—with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the mother’s health. He would team up with National Republican leaders who want to cut funding for Social Security and Medicare, while raising taxes on the middle class. And unlike Dan who is taking on price gouging at the gas pump, Paul Junge would side with Big Oil companies, because he bought over $100,000 in ExxonMobil stock to make himself richer while you pay more.

This is what we are up against. Elections are a choice, and with Michiganders already voting, we need to make sure everyone in our community knows the real, meaningful differences between Dan and his opponent. Unfortunately, conveying our messages is expensive, and we need your help.

Folks, it’s getting real.
Next week, Wade will take the stage to face off against Buddy Carter in two debates.
First up will be the Atlanta Press Club debate on Tuesday, October 18th at 4:15pm – the first time the APC has hosted a debate for Congressional candidates in the 1st District.
Then the next day, WTOC will host the 2nd debate on Wednesday, October 19th at 7pm in Savannah and air it LIVE (again, a first!).
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP30/1/91050/images/debate.png]
We’ll be in touch with the livestream link for the Atlanta Press Club debate.
If you’re in town and around, we hope you can join us at The Sentient Bean in Savannah on Wednesday to watch the WTOC debate!

On Wednesday, President Biden designated Camp Hale and the Tenmile Range as a national monument — the first of his presidency. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52607219/372834243/727864182?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20221014_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZjk0MjdmMC1lYTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yTnMjg54Q0CMAn8N-YTs2bG5-gElfd6PcDKS9E5F-aA=) Wednesday was a historic day for Colorado, folks. **On Wednesday, President Biden designated Camp Hale and the Tenmile Range as a national monument — the first of his presidency.** Now, more than 53,000 acres of Colorado’s public lands will be permanently protected for my children and for yours. clean_body: On Wednesday, President Biden designated Camp Hale and the Tenmile Range as a national monument — the first of his presidency. | = Wednesday was a historic day for Colorado, folks. On Wednesday, President Biden designated Camp Hale and the Tenmile Range as a national monument — the first of his presidency. Now, more than 53,000 acres of Colorado’s public lands will be permanently protected for my children and for yours. Coloradans are committed to defending our state’s history and natural beauty, and that is especially true of Camp Hale, the iconic site where our World War II service members trained to fight, and later returned to found much of our ski industry. For years, I worked alongside World War II veterans, their descendants, and local communities to get this done, and as their voice in the Senate, I called on President Biden to permanently protect Camp Hale and the Tenmile Range. Together, the people of Colorado delivered this win. As long as I am Colorado’s Senator, you can count on me to fight for you and protect our state’s public lands. body:
The next few hours are critical, because tomorrow at midnight we end our mid-month fundraising drive.
#

Friend —
Mark is my best friend, my partner, and my rock. I feel so lucky to have him by my side every day.
He’s helped me through my darkest moments and he always fights for what is right.
At war, he flew in combat, and at peace he joined NASA and commanded the space shuttle twice.
Mark never planned to be a senator, but he knows when it’s time to serve. He’s served his family, our country, and now the great state of Arizona.
But if he’s going to win re-election, he needs your help. And the next few hours are critical, because tomorrow at midnight we end our mid-month fundraising drive. This is the last mid-month fundraising drive before the election, so Mark is really counting on us to make it our best yet.
We need a strong showing today to catch up to where we need to be. Please.

name: Ryan Zinke - Navy SEAL
subject: Closing the curtains on my campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Zinke for Congress
body:
********I’m at my wits’ end, Friend. Pelosi and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. At this point, if I don’t do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will my race be in danger, **_but Republicans may never win another race this year._** **Friend, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump’s Secretary of the Interior and I was the commander at SEAL Team 6.** **I’m also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation. I will never give up on this race, I will never back down - because Navy SEALs never quit.** But if Pelosi can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance. **I have Trump’s endorsement, I lead the team of Navy SEAL’s running for Congress, and I have more battle experience than anyone else.** [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76469%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=XhjmcVSZz1mPYfqVVzsskg&sysid=1) The point is, Friend, I’m the toughest Republican running for office. If I can’t beat Pelosi - no one can. So, I’m going to be blunt with you. [**If you chip in just $5 right now**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76460%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3aIBHelX4X4zkcXL3zlwxw&sysid=1), I can promise you that we will blow my fundraising goal out of the water and ruin Pelosi’s plan to destroy our nation. I’m humbly asking you, as a warrior who’s fought for this nation for my entire life, will you help me out? [**DONATE TODAY**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76461%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CcQINzGWOM8dYFUeRW4b2A&sysid=1) You have my word, as a former Navy SEAL and commander at SEAL Team 6, if you help me out, I will return the favor in Congress. Thank you for your support, Ryan Zinke [**DONATE TODAY**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76461%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=CcQINzGWOM8dYFUeRW4b2A&sysid=1)
