| Peter,
My opponent in the Nevada gubernatorial race has nothing to stand on.
All Steve Sisolak has to show for four years in power is one of the worst education systems in the country, nearly 100,000 businesses that had to close down PERMANENTLY after his draconian COVID orders, and unsafe streets thanks to his soft-on-crime policies like giving lenient sentences for FENTANYL dealers.
But Peter, recently his desperate attempts to campaign on that failed record stooped to a new low...
Sisolak seriously tried to cover for his public safety disasters by blaming them on law enforcement officers like me.
I'll explain more in a minute - but first, if you want to help me beat the politician who tries to blame COPS for his own radical policies, [will you send in support right away so we can have the resources to win this neck-and-neck race? >>](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001RtHZMYG7oPpVzFFGvgyAAqAmg4lxS4hU9bsxiEEwdYCzYb8wgWEpdPf2c9q2lfLQQ5Zi14wmHQ9W7FeChSXRF9vQE48f5taN8J-3yM-AzDR4B51AcGSOjvI-2vCYzgYmljK7QpswPFDroxxsuOKPuT2u1GzxVwJZlImWlD5Lf5KjhvWSgIK0eRgTXlLkQgySXpWtb0cqm3ZeA5FrS8j7dVVXqfVk1kUZFA4_1QQuZyrMSQ3cazDDJAWsvae_JNFy&c=oi1AQXuXd8iSCaZMTw_cc8qClAvsJ8xzm1SAMX_gTX0Px_IWKw_aCA==&ch=adrDM87PxT6wLWz6C-MJJmz4bu5us7Af8dakT69suSCdsBCQqb8HBQ==)

| Peter, Sisolak has tied the hands of law enforcement again and again. Those of us who actually see the realities of crime every day can see that. It's why I've been endorsed by 16 of 17 sheriffs in this state and major law enforcement groups across the board.
But rather than take the hint and own up to his failures, Steve took the opposite approach. He tried to pin rising crime in Nevada not on his terrible decisions (like letting a pipe bomb murderer out of jail... seriously), but on the brave men and women who wear the badge day in and day out.
It was shameful.
I can take attacks like this, Peter, - I get that it's part of the ugly side of campaigning. But when he implied that every officer on my team - brave folks who put their lives on the line constantly - weren't doing their jobs properly with his despicable anti-police rhetoric? That was beyond the pale.
We have to stop him this year. Election Day is just weeks away, and we can't afford to leave anything up to chance.
The future of Nevada is on the line. And we can either re-elect a Governor who has us on the trajectory of California with his soft-on-crime policies, all while he pins the blame on cops...
...or, we can get Law Enforcement Leadership that knows what it takes to actually keep this state safe.
[If you can see what's at stake, then I'm not asking for a lot - even a campaign contribution of $10 or more goes a long way toward competing with this radical Governor. I'll explain more in a minute - but first, if you want to help me beat the politician who tries to blame COPS for his own radical policies, == | | == | Peter, Sisolak has tied the hands of law enforcement again and again. Those of us who actually see the realities of crime every day can see that. It's why I've been endorsed by 16 of 17 sheriffs in this state and major law enforcement groups across the board. But rather than take the hint and own up to his failures, Steve took the opposite approach. He tried to pin rising crime in Nevada not on his terrible decisions (like letting a pipe bomb murderer out of jail... seriously), but on the brave men and women who wear the badge day in and day out. It was shameful. I can take attacks like this, Peter, - I get that it's part of the ugly side of campaigning. But when he implied that every officer on my team - brave folks who put their lives on the line constantly - weren't doing their jobs properly with his despicable anti-police rhetoric? That was beyond the pale. We have to stop him this year. Election Day is just weeks away, and we can't afford to leave anything up to chance. The future of Nevada is on the line. And we can either re-elect a Governor who has us on the trajectory of California with his soft-on-crime policies, all while he pins the blame on cops... ...or, we can get Law Enforcement Leadership that knows what it takes to actually keep this state safe. == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | Thank you for your critical support, Sheriff Joe Lombardo | | Lombardo for Governor | == | == == == | | | | | | | Lombardo for Governor | P.O. #

Friends -
Since Gabby started her fight to make our communities safer from gun violence, Giffords has received almost 1 million individual online donations to fund that work.
We’re going to ask you to make your first online donation today, but before we do, we thought it important to tell you how we use these resources to advance our shared goals.
First, the midterm elections are just weeks away and we’re working hard to elect a Congress that will take further action to make our communities safer from gun violence.
Second, we are working tirelessly at the state level to pass laws that make people safer in some states, while in others we are fighting the gun lobby to prevent the passage of laws that make us less safe.
Also, we work closely with lawmakers at the local, state, and federal levels, serving as experts to ensure they have accurate information before crafting or voting on important gun safety legislation.
And it’s also critical to note that the size of our grassroots movement is a big part of the reason members of Congress have moved so much on this issue over the years.

Last year, I joined the Vermont National Guard as a 19 year old, and I had a horrible experience. My friends and I were bullied and sexually harassed and assaulted. **** Fortunately, I’ve known Brenda my whole life, and she was there for me when I needed to get out of an unsafe situation. When I finally came home from the National Guard, she offered me a safe place to stay. I know that as governor, she will make sure everyone in our state has a place. She cares deeply about the most vulnerable Vermonters, and she won’t stop until everyone gets the resources they need and can thrive in our state. | I’m with Brenda because I know Brenda will work to take care of everyone in our state, just like how she takes care of me. She’s a bold leader who knows how to get things done, and as governor, she would move our state in the right direction. Brenda needs our help reaching every Vermonter and informing them of her plans to build a better Vermont. She needs $3550 to reach her goal for this week as we enter into the last 25 days of the campaign. | Hi there,

Election Day is in less than 4 weeks, and every day between now and Nov. 8th, voters will choose between Dan and his extreme opponent, Paul Junge. **[Click here to help us reach undecided voters before they cast their ballots.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52620005/372853851/1325960132?amount=15&contactdata=YkDJF8XJNPa76teFuApgc88opSjPYtXAlKf5zGGw8z0LFjqRiN3vw0hmKTSa9Tz9l2KojZWECa%2FaqF1cLStw2UXuCUmygsmNh%2B06tyqYNzI396i%2B%2FU2cdpeuAqzabCsx9KUYpmR4DtdNV9gbX0pOFw%3D%3D&refcode2=a209674b-f74b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&source=EM_NBI_DK_20221014_FR_1.3_0_NO_CM_NA_NA_resend&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMjA5Njc0Yi1mNzRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ch5gEJ5CsgECp84EXeSp0PJ77pSVQn6cjoubgwUW99A=)**

Here are three things every mid-Michigan voter should know before casting their ballot:
* **_Paul Junge is not from here, having spent 43 years outside of Michigan._** He grew up in San Diego—having graduated high school, college, and law school in California. He’s lived outside of Michigan for over four decades and only rented an apartment in Grand Blanc to run for Congress.

* **_Paul Junge is using his million-dollar trust fund to try and buy a seat in Congress._** He has already contributed over $1.25 million of his own money to try and buy this congressional seat, despite not owning a home in mid-Michigan. He’s a multi-millionaire living off his family’s trust fund, who is out of touch with the needs of working families.

* **_Paul Junge is too extreme for mid-Michigan._** He supports an abortion ban—with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the mother’s health. He would team up with National Republican leaders who want to cut funding for Social Security and Medicare, while raising taxes on the middle class. And unlike Dan who is taking on price gouging at the gas pump, Paul Junge would side with Big Oil companies, because he bought over $100,000 in ExxonMobil stock to make himself richer while you pay more.

This is what we are up against. Elections are a choice, and with Michiganders already voting, we need to make sure everyone in our community knows the real, meaningful differences between Dan and his opponent. Unfortunately, conveying our messages is expensive, and we need your help.

**[That’s why we set a goal to raise $10,000 online this week to expand our organizing district-wide in these final weeks. Rush $15 today to help us hit our goal. | Peter,
We've been through so much together this year - not just in politics but as people in general. Things have just been so crazy. The number one thing we learned is that our country can be broken incredibly quickly.
We've watched as Joe Biden destroyed everything that was built over the previous four years. We've also watched as establishment politicians from both parties did so little to stop him in his destructive tirade.
Failure is not the end. Those values that led me off the Democrat plantation when I was a Junior in college are the same values that led me to run for office. Those same values lead me now to stay involved in the fight for our country because I know that we need true representation that is not beholden to the establishment on both sides. We need representatives beholden to the people.
This election will determine whether or not we have a free country left on this earth. It sounds dramatic, but it's true. America is the last truly free nation on this planet BUT that freedom is fast slipping away. We don't have a Plan B. We MUST fight for the land that we love!

body:
ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
We’re about halfway through the month, so as Campaign Treasurer, I’ve been checking in on our numbers to make sure we’re on track to reach our final fundraising targets of the election.
I’m proud of the campaign we’ve built together here in Texas, and it’s been amazing to see it really come alive in the final weeks before the election as we work together to re-elect a strong, effective leader in TX-07. We have events planned nearly every day between now and November 8 to get out the vote — for Lizzie and for Democrats running in Harris County, Fort Bend County, and statewide. With 70% of voters new to the district, we have a lot to do and a lot planned.
Your contributions make it possible. They keep our TV ad on the air for people across the Houston media market to see — that’s about 2.5 million homes and voters in 23 counties getting the message to get out and vote. They also put mail in more than 100,000 mailboxes. They put ads in the newspapers and online.
And they fuel our organizing efforts to knock on doors and show up where voters and potential voters are with a compelling message about the stakes in this election. With a little more than three weeks left to go, they make all the difference.
If you’re able to make a contribution, it will make a difference right now as we invest in the things that will power us through the election and on to victory! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe221014?refcode=lpfe221014]

name: Val Demings
subject: persevering
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=1097%2E5257348%2Ex_PaZX ]Adam Schiff for Congress

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em_demings.GyjgkE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221014_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=1097%2E5257348%2Ex_PaZX ]Val Demings

Derek —

Each and every day, it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly
be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could
decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.

But I know a thing or two about persevering, and winning, even when the
odds are stacked against me. That’s why Adam Schiff asked me to reach out
once again.

So I have to ask: [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1230?c0=oct2022_abs_em_demings.kDGYVT&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221014_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=1097%2E5257348%2Ex_PaZX ]If you’re ready to stand with me, and defeat Marco
Rubio in one of the closest Senate races in the entire country, please
chip in $5 now to our campaigns. If not, please keep reading, and I hope
to explain why this campaign is so important.

Derek, I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life. There is
nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated
South. But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me
perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words — "never
tire of doing good, Val” — that gave me the strength to get to where I am
today.

I carry the spirit of her words with me still – as I reflect on my career
of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em_demings.GyjgkE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221014_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=1097%2E5257348%2Ex_PaZX ]Old family photo of Val Demings as a child with siblings and parents

There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate –
nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police
Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see
a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and
eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of
police.

They called me “Chief Demings.” Has a nice ring to it, don’t you think?

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em_demings.GyjgkE&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221014_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=1097%2E5257348%2Ex_PaZX ]Val Demings photographed in uniform beside her police motorcycle

And Derek, I know firsthand that there's nothing easy about
winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my
toughest fights – and I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my

This week, Erik unveiled his next campaign ad focused on the 2019 Colorado law making a lethal amount of fentanyl a misdemeanor.

| "Too many families in Colorado and across the nation have suffered from the fentanyl crisis coming through our open borders," stated Aadland. "Fentanyl deaths are up 384% since this time last year and there have already been over 1,000 fentanyl deaths in 2022 because many victims are unaware this is the drug they are taking. These overdoses have impacted more parents than we ever could have expected. Unfortunately, a major contributor to these overdoses is the lack of proper punishment for the criminals distributing this toxic narcotic. Our children must be protected and the perpetrators to these overdoses must be punished. The soft-on-crime law sponsored by my opponent in 2019, which lessened the punishment for possession of a lethal amount of fentanyl, has harmed Colorado families. We need leadership in Washington that helps keep our families safe by putting the hammer down on criminals with stiff sentences."

subject: Vote this Week!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
The big ask from me today isn't for money, it's literally for your vote. | |
---
Hi friend, By now, you should have received your ballot. It's definitely time to reach out to your county clerk if you have not! The big ask from me today isn't for money, it's literally for your vote. I know many people put off voting for a while, but I'm asking you not to this year. There are two main reasons to vote early: 1.) It guarantees you don't misplace your ballot over the next few weeks - without enough time to get a replacement, and with something coming up that stops you from voting in person at the polls. 2.) Logistically, it's far easier on campaigns trying to dial up their Get Out The Vote operations if their supporters vote early. It's impossible to tell which voters plan to vote for me - but later - from voters who lean Democratic but may not vote at all. So, today, I want you to open your ballot up, pencil in the circle next to my name (and, hopefully, some other good candidates at the state/county/city level), and mail it in. This election is important, make sure your voice is heard. Vote. Thanks for all the support so far! Remember to vote!

Max

I lost the first election I ever ran in, folks.
I’m worried that, unless our fundraising picks up, that could happen again this cycle. If it does, Democrats won’t just lose New Hampshire – we’ll lose our Senate majority right along with it.

name: Connor Boyack
subject: Debunking 40 popular political and economic myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zb2upuefve4vmn37dso86spc4gd2d0nfnbuj67h8_rp22sh2s8i66or5ctjm1pb4chh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcepkhmm08lfhtfjb4ce8bl7rnnjg8pr19an6nq8_rp22sh2s8i66or5ctjm1pb4chh2bs)**

---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ze0te337q9b6cqdqiuvh24soi1sjc7laoqqgor58_rp22sh2s8i66or5ctjm1pb4chh2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zppkls0707ljp1stpb2n9vndl5jpo1ht5mcldjd0_rp22sh2s8i66or5ctjm1pb4chh2bs)**_ today!
Thank you,

Connor Boyack
Author, Tuttle Twins
Founder, Libertas Institute

name: Joe Kent
subject: My opponent is after your guns.
body:
Dear Peter,
I was surprised that at our last debate, my opponent Marie Perez declared her support for a ban on new firearm purchases.
While she pretends to be a "moderate," there's nothing moderate about her, especially her public attack on our Second Amendment and your family's right to defend yourself.
Please help me defeat her by contributing today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate?](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/7635DBsnxUsSD3Z3GGGRw9pw/VSnrnRV18hqDxIH9XnqdTA).
Here's the irony: She's bragged about owning the same so-called "assault rifle" that she wants to ban Americans from purchasing.
This is typical of the left: they want you disarmed and vulnerable but would never allow themselves to suffer the same.
She wants to take away the rights of millions of Americans, including members of our military, to protect themselves and their families, all while she owns the same rifles she would ban us from purchasing.
Make sure a hypocrite like my opponent Perez doesn't get anywhere near elected office by donating at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/7635DBsnxUsSD3Z3GGGRw9pw/VSnrnRV18hqDxIH9XnqdTA).
Let me make clear to you my stance on the Second Amendment: I understand the meaning of "shall not be infringed." Unlike my opponent, I will be a warrior for the Second Amendment and am proud to be endorsed by Gun Owners of America.
Respectfully,
Joe Kent

PS: We can't let this seat slip into the hands of a gun-grabber like Marie Perez. Polls have us only a few points apart, please help me get across the finish line with a donation at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/7635DBsnxUsSD3Z3GGGRw9pw/VSnrnRV18hqDxIH9XnqdTA)!

The proprietors of these local shops speak mostly in Spanish. I heard their struggles with making rent, staying afloat, and how they wished for more Latinos to be engaged in the voting process. **January 2006**
That was the month and year we launched VoteVets. We had no idea how it’d turn out, but never imagined in a million years we’d be one of the largest outside spending organizations every election cycle.
**January 3, 2013**
Tammy Duckworth is sworn into the House of Representatives. We supported Tammy way back when, even before this race. We’ve also helped to elect candidates you love like Ruben Gallego, Ted Lieu, Gary Peters, and many more.

Dear Friends,
Join Our campaign this weekend as we reach voters fed up with inflation. We will be out in supermarkets in the towns of Arlington at Stop and Shop located at 905 Massachusetts Ave. Lexington at Stop and Shop located at 36 Bedford Street and Market Basket in Waltham located at 110 Marketplace. All volunteers will be out between the hours of 10 am and 4:30 pm at local supermarkets engaging voters. Please feel free to assist us reach voters. Gather friends, pick up literature and reach voters. You don't need to be in one of those places to help. Go to your local shopping location and hand out flyers. Our campaign will provide flyers if you need them. We only are reaching voters in the 5th Congressional District. Here is a list of cities and towns in the district.
Arlington Bedford Precinct 2A Belmont Cambridge Ward 3 Precinct 3A Ward 4 Precinct 2 Ward 6 Precincts 1A, 2, 3Ward 7 Precincts 1, 2, 3 Ward 8 Precincts 1, 2, 3 Ward 9 Precincts 1, 2, 3Ward 10 Precinct 1A, 2Ward 11 Precinct 3 Framingham Lexington Lincoln Malden Maynard Medford Melrose Natick Stoneham Sudbury Waltham Watertown Wayland Weston Winchester Woburn Norfolk County Wellesley Precincts A, B, C, D, G, H Suffolk County Revere Winthrop
Simply hand shoppers one of our flyers asking them to vote Caroline Colarusso for Congress on their way out of the store. Please don't block any entrances and be on the sidewalk and not in the store. Please be kind, respectful and polite.
If you are interested in volunteering but don't know quite how to, you may attend a training class tomorrow Saturday October 15th at 5 pm at 4 Patrick Circle in Stoneham. You may also pick up material and literature to hand to voters there also at 4 Patrick Circle. Please email in advance if you are attending the training or picking up literature. Election Day is approaching fast. This November’s election will decide the makeup of the U.S. Senate and the future of critical programs like Medicare and Social Security.

When it comes to health care and retirement security, where do you stand? Expand and improve, or privatize and sunset?

Below, In Union aims to clarify the positions of our two candidates for the U.S. Senate, Lt. Gov. John Fetterman and former TV personality Dr. Mehmet Oz.
---
**JOHN FETTERMAN**

John Fetterman believes health care — including access to reproductive health care — is a fundamental right, as basic as housing, food, and education. As Lt. Governor, Fetterman worked with Governor Wolf to protect high-quality health care for 2.2 million Pennsylvanians.
* Vowed to protect Social Security, calling it a “critical lifeline for PA’s seniors,” and believes the ability to retire with dignity is “at the heart of the basic American bargain.” _1_
* Believes health care is a “basic, fundamental human right, no different than food or shelter.” _2_
* Has condemned calls from Senate Republicans to eliminate Social Security and Medicare as federal entitlement programs. _3_
* Believes we must lower the Medicare eligibility age to 60 while expanding coverage to include vision, hearing, and dental. _4_

| **MEHMET OZ**

Former TV personality Dr. Mehmet Oz has proposed privatizing Medicare, which would allow insurance companies to raise premiums and deny care to people with preexisting conditions. He’s also promised to support the schemes of some Republican senators that could eliminate Social Security and jeopardize benefits for millions of seniors.
* Proposed privatizing Medicare and expanding “Medicare Advantage” programs, which are known to deny claims that would be covered under normal Medicare. _5_
* Proposes raising payroll taxes to 20%, passing the cost of health care onto working people. _6_
* Wants to give insurance companies more power to raise premiums and deny coverage. _7_
* Voiced support for a plan that could eliminate Social Security and Medicare, while allowing Wall Street to make billions off of beneficiaries and raising taxes to 35% on Pennsylvanians. _8_
* According to financial disclosures, Oz and his wife own up to $600,000 in stock for health care companies, which would stand to benefit from privatized Medicare. _9_

clean_body: Medicare and the U.S. Senate Election. | | | | COMPARING THE CANDIDATES FOR U.S. SENATE ON MEDICARE & SOCIAL SECURITY Election Day is approaching fast. This November’s election will decide the makeup of the U.S. Senate and the future of critical programs like Medicare and Social Security. When it comes to health care and retirement security, where do you stand? Expand and improve, or privatize and sunset? Below, In Union aims to clarify the positions of our two candidates for the U.S. Senate, Lt. Gov. John Fetterman and former TV personality Dr. Mehmet Oz. JOHN FETTERMAN John Fetterman believes health care — including access to reproductive health care — is a fundamental right, as basic as housing, food, and education. As Lt. Governor, Fetterman worked with Governor Wolf to protect high-quality health care for 2.2 million Pennsylvanians. Vowed to protect Social Security, calling it a “critical lifeline for PA’s seniors,” and believes the ability to retire with dignity is “at the heart of the basic American bargain.” 1 Believes health care is a “basic, fundamental human right, no different than food or shelter.” 2 Has condemned calls from Senate Republicans to eliminate Social Security and Medicare as federal entitlement programs. 3 Believes we must lower the Medicare eligibility age to 60 while expanding coverage to include vision, hearing, and dental. 4 | MEHMET OZ Former TV personality Dr. Mehmet Oz has proposed privatizing Medicare, which would allow insurance companies to raise premiums and deny care to people with preexisting conditions. He’s also promised to support the schemes of some Republican senators that could eliminate Social Security and jeopardize benefits for millions of seniors. Proposed privatizing Medicare and expanding “Medicare Advantage” programs, which are known to deny claims that would be covered under normal Medicare. 5 Proposes raising payroll taxes to 20%, passing the cost of health care onto working people. 6 Wants to give insurance companies more power to raise premiums and deny coverage. 7 Voiced support for a plan that could eliminate Social Security and Medicare, while allowing Wall Street to make billions off of beneficiaries and raising taxes to 35% on Pennsylvanians. 8 According to financial disclosures, Oz and his wife own up to $600,000 in stock for health care companies, which would stand to benefit from privatized Medicare. 9 ---|--- CHECK THE FACTS: 1\. ; . 2. . 3. . 4. . 5. ; ; . 6. . 7. ; . 8. ; . 9. . Fellow Conservative,

There is so much going on out here in Oregon that**I’m having difficulty putting my thoughts down on paper** , so I’m going to give you some bullet points to help you better comprehend just how in-play my race and others up and down the ballot in Oregon are next month:

1. According to an internal poll we conducted this past week, our race is neck-and-neck

2. Voters are so FED UP with the Democrat governor, it is starting to look like -- for the first time since 1982 -- a Republican has a real shot at winning that race. That only helps us with voters; there is no downside

3. **President Biden is being forced to visit the state Saturday to try and stem the bleeding of support for progressive politicians**.

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

clean_body: What songs should we include on our 2022 Voting Playlist? Submit your suggestions here. | | | Hey there, The midterm elections are in full swing, and the team here at Fair Fight Action wants to make sure you have everything you need to cast your ballot. We’ve been working to advance our mission of expanding ballot access and eliminating voter suppression. We believe that voting should be accessible, safe, and secure — but also,fun. So as you prepare to vote, we need you to check your registration, make a plan to vote as early as possible, and load up our playlist! That’s right, the Fair Fight Action team is building a Voting Playlist for you to listen to when you’re on your way to cast your ballot — and we want your help to make it. | Listen while you’re filling out and submitting your mail-in ballot, heading to the polls with your voting crew, or even during an election night party! Keep an eye out for our Voting Playlist coming soon — you might see your song choice on it! | Hillary here.

People often ask me why I’m doing this. Why, in such a politically divisive time, in an increasingly dangerous time, I am putting myself out there and running for Congress.

The answer is pretty simple.

I want my kids and the kids in my neighborhood and across West Michigan to have a bright and prosperous future. I want the women and girls who come behind us to have more, not less rights. I want to pass on to our next generation a clean and livable world. I want safe communities for our children to play in.

**And frankly, if you want something done right, just send in a busy working mom to get it done.**

In Washington, I'll fight like a mother for families across West Michigan. I'll fight for safer communities, I'll fight for quality education, and most of all, I'll fight for women and girls across West Michigan. Hi, we're reaching out this morning to give you a quick overview of where things stand with just 25 days left in this race:
* Jen's on the air with her first ad of the general election, drawing a strong contrast with Chris Carr's extreme positions on choice

body:
We have to fully fund our GOTV efforts.
#
Derek,
**We have less than a week until our final FEC deadline before the election.** That means we’ll have to close our books and report our final fundraising numbers.
There are ✌️ big reasons why this is important:
1. Oz and all his dark money PACs will look at our final numbers and make a judgment about the strength of our campaign.
2. We need to raise as much as possible to show that our grassroots campaign has what it takes to win AND fully fund our GOTV field program for the last four weeks of the campaign.

**[Derek, will you help us fund our critical voter outreach efforts and reach our 100,000 donation goal before our final FEC deadline? We only have a week left to raise all the funds we need.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221014-2?refcode=em20221014-7712&refcode2=7712_434096_1l82z5&akid=7712%2E434096%2E1l82z5)**
**[RUSH $5 NOW »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221014-2?amount=5&refcode=em20221014-7712&refcode2=7712_434096_1l82z5&akid=7712%2E434096%2E1l82z5)**
Our GOTV plan is one of the most important parts (if not THE most important part) of our campaign right now. And we’ll need to spend our *entire* GOTV budget before November 8th to make sure we get every voter to the polls.
So we need to recruit as many volunteers to knock on as many doors as possible. And we need snacks, clipboards, pens, and paper for our volunteers to have all the materials they need.
**[Will you fund our critical voter outreach efforts today by making a contribution today, Derek? Your gift will also bring us one donation closer to reaching our goal before our final FEC deadline on October 19th.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20221014-2?refcode=em20221014-7712&refcode2=7712_434096_1l82z5&akid=7712%2E434096%2E1l82z5)**

Thank you for your support today,
Team Fetterman

From a very young age, Mandela saw the power of grassroots organizing and what is possible when people come together to challenge the status quo. It's what led him to run for state representative, and then for Lieutenant Governor of Wisconsin.

As Lieutenant Governor he has led efforts across the state to address the climate crisis, and enable Wisconsin to respond effectively to the COVID pandemic. Bernie Sanders

body:
Peter’s record speaks for itself

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1076%2E61531%2Ec0iuZZ)
Hi there,
Yesterday’s debate showed us exactly what we already knew to be true: **Peter Welch is the right choice for Vermont, and we can’t risk our opponent winning.**
We heard more of the same extreme views that are out-of-touch with what most Vermonters want, like his support for the _Dobbs_ decision overturning _Roe v. Wade_ , and him doubling down on his comments that he wished he was in Washington on January 6th.
[**We can’t risk someone with these views gaining momentum in this race, not when the election is 25 days away and there’s so much at stake. So please, if you’re as fired up as we are, will you chip in $5 or anything you can to help Peter defeat his opponent and win this race?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4604?t=3&akid=1076%2E61531%2Ec0iuZZ)

Vermont’s next senator should be someone who represents Vermont values, and who’s focused solutions, community, and integrity—not who gets credit. And the fact is, Peter’s record speaks for itself. He’s worked across the aisle to focus on shared problems and get solutions to benefit _all_ people—like funding for energy efficiency retrofitting. And he’s fighting for climate action, abortion rights, and lower health care costs.
Unfortunately, yesterday’s debate proved that if elected, Peter’s opponent would do more to represent Mitch McConnell and national Republicans than Vermonters. They have their sights set on flipping the Senate red—and they only need to pick up one seat to do it. They want to ban abortion, raise taxes on the middle-class, and restrict voting rights. We can’t let that happen. With our entire progressive agenda at stake, it’s up to us to come together and defend our democracy.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**Regional Organizing Directors**
The Indiana Democratic Party is hiring Regional Organizing Directors to to build a stronger party in the field throughout the Hoosier State. The role is ideal for someone looking to be more involved in politics and party building and who wants to dedicate themselves to learning more about the inner workings of campaigns, strategic planning, and voter targeting and contact. These are important roles to building back a fair and equitable two party system of government in Indiana.
For full job descriptions and how to apply visit our website at https://www.indems.org/jobs/
**\- On the Porch with John Gregg -**
****
A new PBS show, "On The Porch with John Gregg” recently premiered, and we’re excited to let you know how you can view it.

Season 1 of "On The Porch” is a 13-episode run in which our old friend John visits with fellow Hoosiers from across the state and shares with viewers the musical talents of an array of Indiana artists.

Episodes that have aired so far feature storytelling by John and visits from the Indiana Historical Society CEO, a Beatles expert (did you know John saw the Beatles at the Indiana State Fairgrounds?!), a Hoop Fish Net Maker (you have got to see it to believe it!), and an Indiana Landmarks director who discusses a giant peach and a stuffed dog as well as a little more mainstream Hoosier landmarks.

But that’s not all! Indiana musicians are also showcased, and you’ll see fiddle & banjo music from Orange County’s own Stephen & Nancy Dickey, John getting a guitar lesson, an old school One Man Band, and a father-son duo talk about and demonstrate traditional African drum making.

We’re really proud that John continues to contribute to the state by sharing wonderful Hoosier stories and culture with viewers everywhere.

If you live within the Vincennes PBS viewing area, you can watch “On The Porch” every Saturday at 8p EST. Following that broadcast, the show is available for viewing from anywhere in the world(!) at the Vincennes PBS YouTube channel:
[https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC18oKQvHzxR63E78CJOzJrQ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52623898/372856813/-322606614?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMTRhMTRmNC1mOTRiLWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pSIDhYzac9VuFmwjUwyYJ_wGPATrDYngt6H0TKtr-TA=&emci=5f9cf038-f04b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=c14a14f4-f94b-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=4925535)

Fellow American,

**MSNBC is at it again - attacking me and tearing down conservative Christians who support our campaign. **

When Democrats have no ground to stand on, they _**ALWAYS**_ pivot to attacking Republicans on social issues.

We are seeing this right now in the Georgia Senate race. _Democrats have no desire to talk about crime in our neighborhoods, rising gas prices, open borders, or 40-year high inflation._

Instead, they want to distract voters from the real issues, so they attack me personally and make up lie after lie. And now, they're coming after you, too.

This week, I joined Fox News Channel’s primetime show “The Ingraham Angle” to draw attention to the fight local districts are facing because of the SAFE-T Act. We also talked about how the extremism of JB Pritzker, Sean Casten, and Illinois Democrats is impacting the 2022 race.

In the interview, I told Laura Ingraham, “I am going to flip this seat.” I am confident that we can win, and **I am doing everything I can - day in and day out - to make sure we do. But I need your help!**

Nancy Pelosi and special interests groups are pouring money into Sean Casten’s campaign to make sure they hold on to this seat and continue with their extreme agenda in Washington.[ We don’t have much time to catch up to their fundraising!](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=1a8654053b&e=7dd0b93d07) **We have a critical deadline coming up in 2 days! **

Unlike Sean Casten - who has made a career out of benefiting himself and the special interests who fund his campaign - I am running to represent YOU.

I’m ready to take on Nancy Pelosi and the special interests in DC to make our streets safe, restore a strong economy.

[Now is the time to get in this fight! Help me keep our message out loud and clear over the next three weeks with a donation in any amount TODAY!](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=cb43a7bc03&e=7dd0b93d07)

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois' Sixth Congressional District_

| _**In Case You Missed It**_
**DuPage Policy Journal: Sean Casten is disingenuous and hypocritical on climate change' after a 6,000 mile flight to combat climate change**
_According to the[Washington Free Beacon](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=a3ae9ef77e&e=7dd0b93d07), Sean Casten traveled to Iceland in late August through early September alongside the Aspen Institute on the think tank's congressional trip. The Democrat's travel disclosures reveal that Casten flew business class from Chicago to Reykjavík, Iceland, and back—a roundtrip flight that totals 5,888 miles and emits more than 313,000 pounds of carbon dioxide, given that on average, planes produce 53.3 pounds of carbon dioxide per mile traveled. Casten's lodging took place at a luxury European hotel complete with private meals and a $5,000 total price tag.

This summer, [redgreenandblue.org](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=9bb180bb7f&e=7dd0b93d07) referred to Casten as "Congress’ fiercest climate hawk" and noted he's a member of the House Select Committee on the Climate Crisis.

The Beacon points out Casten did not actually need to travel thousands of miles on a gas-guzzling flight to meet with many of the climate "leaders" the Aspen Institute assembled, as a majority of the scholars he met with are based in the states. For example, the trip's schedule reveals a pair of roundtable discussions on day one of the trip featured Polar Institute senior fellow Sherri Goodman, Harvard University's Meghan O'Sullivan, and Rockefeller Foundation president Rajiv Shah, all of whom are based in the United States.

The Democrat has a history of successfully pushing for hundreds of billions of dollars in green energy spending while also holding a stake of up to $500,000 in Greenleaf Power, a Sacramento-based green energy company that will likely benefit from the spending, the Beacon says.

“Sean Casten is disingenuous and hypocritical on climate change," Pekau said in a press release. "The only impact he has had in Congress has been on his own bottom line. The combination of Casten’s insolent self-dealing and Biden’s distressing incompetence has been a disaster. I am running for Congress to restore common sense leadership to Washington DC...”

Congress voting data from [FiveThirtyEight](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=f3e9c9b2a0&e=7dd0b93d07) shows Casten has voted with Biden 99% of the time since first joining Congress in 2019._

[Read the full op-ed here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=501da870ac&e=7dd0b93d07)

**ABC-7: Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau, Rep Sean Casten present voters with clear choice in 6th District**
One of the key Illinois congressional races next month has two-term incumbent Democrat Sean Casten facing off against Republican Keith Pekau, who is the current mayor of Orland Park...

Casten and Pekau are presenting voters a clear choice in this election.

[Watch the report here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=ad120e418a&e=7dd0b93d07)

# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
| **Jeffery Carter at Points and Figures Blog: It’s Over for the Economy, Deep Recession**
_How high is inflation?[Inflation numbers are out today.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=3642631745&e=7dd0b93d07) CPI is up 8.2%. The last three numbers are 9.1% and 8.3%, so look for Biden’s press secretary to say they are winning the battle on inflation. The core price index was steady at up .6%.Housing prices make up a large piece of CPI and many Americans have a lot of their personal wealth tied up in their home. Housing prices have cracked and are in a bear market. Real estate markets all over the country are frozen. Food prices are skyrocketing up by 1.2%.

Joe Biden tried to say we “might go into a small recession”. He’s an idiot and this economy is all on him. We are in a recession and we are going into a deep one. I don’t see anything changing until at a bare minimum 2026.

If the [Biden Administration ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=6ce1acb283&e=7dd0b93d07)didn’t do two things we wouldn’t be in as bad a shape as we are. They are:_

1. _A total all-out war on American fossil fuels_
2. _Massive increases in government spending_

_We would still have some inflation due to Covid. But, the deliberate actions of Biden and the Congressional Democrats put more fuel on the pyre and lit it._

[Read Jeff’s full analysis here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=a112e7c88f&e=7dd0b93d07)

**Wirepoints.com: More things wrong with Illinois’ SAFE-T Act**
_The additional issues beyond the Act’s altered pre-trial detention standards are several: _
1. _The Act as currently adopted weakens the leeway of police to arrest for certain misdemeanor offenses including trespassing._
2. _It undercuts fair play in police disciplinary proceedings in two ways that contribute to ongoing retirements and resignations of sworn officers and related staffing shortfalls in Illinois police and sheriff’s departments statewide: anonymous complaints and an end to sworn affidavits. This in turn has the potential over time to significantly compromise public safety as more and more police leave agencies statewide. _
3. _The SAFE-T Act also poses unreasonable risks to crime victims and other potential witnesses by weakening the rules for charged suspects out on electronic monitoring before trial. _
4. _In addition, the Act and approved amendments to it have so far failed to address operational and budgetary challenges of requiring that law enforcement agencies implement widespread usage of body-worn cameras. _

[Read the full report here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=0e4909ce44&e=7dd0b93d07)

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Senator Raphael Warnock
subject: My debate with Herschel Walker
body:
Derek,
Herschel Walker and I just wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day.
I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, but we have a problem: With experts at FiveThirtyEight saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me.
That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.
We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign, Derek . And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy.
Unlike Walker, I refuse to take a cent from corporate PACs. From the very start, I’ve relied entirely on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory – so I have to urgently ask you in this important moment: Before the midnight deadline, will you split a donation between CommonGood and me to help hit our fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue? Spanish-speakers needed for bilingual virtual phonebanking!
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221014-3499-header&t=1&akid=3499%2E2526796%2EnuUbg5)
You may have heard that voter turnout is down everywhere, including New York City. But turning out folks to the polls is key to keeping our movement strong and our allies in office. They may have the money, but we have the people - it’s time to yet again demonstrate the power of the masses against corporate interests.
Let's call on our neighbors to fight for a better world in November and re-elect Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez to Congress!
**[RSVP here »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/15054?utm_source=em20221014-3499&t=2&akid=3499%2E2526796%2EnuUbg5)**
**These phone banks will specifically target Spanish-speaking residents of NY-14, so bilingual volunteers are needed.** Otherwise, no previous experience is necessary! Each call will begin with a short virtual information session hosted by the AOC team with a computer and phone to participate.
[Click here for more details and sign up for a shift!](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/15054?utm_source=em20221014-3499&t=3&akid=3499%2E2526796%2EnuUbg5)
* * *
¡Llamemos a nuestros vecinos para luchar por un mejor mundo en noviembre y reelegir Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez al Congreso!
Este año la participación de votantes ha disminuido y sabemos que nuestro poder está en la unión, creación de relaciones fuertes entre nosotros y las acciones de nuestros vecinos! Unete con tu familia y amigos a nuestro día de acción.
¡No se necesita experiencia previa! Cada llamada comenzará con una breve sesión de información virtual organizada por el equipo de AOC una computadora y un teléfono para participar.
**[Confirmar la asistencia aquí »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/15054?utm_source=em20221014-3499&t=4&akid=3499%2E2526796%2EnuUbg5)**

Hasta pronto!
Con solidaridad,
Team AOC

# **Newsletter-October 14 Vol. 2, #34**
---
| | |
##
14 October 22

Mail-In Ballots are now in the hands of voters and voting has begun. In 2 weeks, early voting begins (Oct 27-Nov 3). We have a lot of work to do! We need your help to get America back on course.

For the first time in 35 years we have an opportunity to make a REAL difference in District 4. Please seize THIS moment!

Due to the Laurel Parade, there will be no sign waving on Saturday.
In leiu of sign waving, come walk with us in the Laurel Parade, tomorrow.

**Walk With Jeff Warner In The Laurel Parade**
The Jeff Warner For Congress Campaign will be walking in the Laurel Main Street Festival Parade, tomorrow, Saturday, Oct 15.
Line up will be around 8:30am and the parade will be finished around 10a.
Meet at 9th Street and Park Ave.
Wear your Jeff Warner For Congress t-shirt. Free t-shirts are provided to those who have not yet received one.

Being so close to election day, it's important that the campaign has a large turnout demonstrating the large support for Jeff Warner.

Please text 240-736-4487 or email Info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com if you'll be attending and how many people you will be bringing including yourself.

**Leave Jeff Warner's Pre-Recorded Message To Voters**
Contact Val for the 15 minute training.
443-386-8303

**Radio Ads**
The campaign will be placing radio ads this week. Please pray for wisdom and guidance. It has been nearly 50 years since a Republican has used mass media for a Congressional campaign.

**Final Donations** The election is coming up soon! Please consider making a generous contribution. The maximum contribution is $2900 per person. Your donation will help us secure our commitments for print ads, radio ads and texting which all need to be purchased in advance. Your donation will help us secure our media commitments.
**Social Media**
Don't miss some of the amazing stories on social media @RepJeffWarner.

**Yard Signs**
We want to begin having yard signs pop-up throughout the District especially for those who live on or near busy roadways.
Yard Signs are FREE, yet we are requesting a minimum $10 donation, if you're in a position to donate.

We are asking you for your donations, for your service, and your prayers. Together, we can do this! This is the power of teamwork! And the Best Is Yet To Come! Please reach out to us at info@JeffWarnerForCongress.com

In 3 weeks, the General Election counting will be in process. Let's Get This Done! Together!

[**Donate Here**](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e2b757c427e67a891eab3e1b8&id=4900e9d37b&e=12a37459a2)

Remember, Jeff Warner is standing with you and for you. Enough is Enough! Together, "We The People" can make a real difference. Now is our time to act. THERE IS HOPE!

Standing with you,

Jeff

What’s almost funny to me is that GOP state leaders like to go on and on about the idea of “freedom.”
But there is nothing “free” about being forced to carry a pregnancy to term because your state government took away your right to choose.
There is nothing “free” about second-guessing a simple trip to the grocery store or sending your kids to school because your state government hasn't done anything to protect you from a mass shooting.
There’s nothing “free” about living somewhere with poor air or water quality because your state government has given businesses a free pass to pollute.
Republican politicians aren’t interested in freedom. They’re interested in total power and control. **That’s why it’s so critical that state legislatures are lead by pro-choice, pro-gun safety, and pro-democracy Democrats. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221014_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=12556%2E1862389%2EnGFdMG ]In a moment, I will ask you to donate to our campaign to create a
Georgia where opportunity is available to everyone — regardless of their
background. But first, I want to tell you a story about why it’s so
important to me to create a state where everyone is given a chance to
thrive.

As the daughter of a librarian, I’ve always loved reading and expanding my
vocabulary. This passion pushed me to enroll in AP English as a high
school Sophomore.

One day in class, I submitted a paper I thought was well written and full
of great insight. I patted myself on the back and expected to receive high
marks on the paper. However, when I got it back, I was flabbergasted — I
received a low grade.

Confused, I asked my teacher why I had received a low mark. She responded
by telling me that I used words that were too big and it made the other
students uncomfortable. So, she told me, I should simplify my language in
class and in assignments.

I responded in a way that only a high school sophomore could cook up: if I
couldn’t use my own words in her class, I would not use any.

Eventually, my parents were called by the school to sort the matter out. I
agreed to end my silent strike, but my parents made it clear: I was there
to learn and improve myself, just like everyone else.

Looking back on this incident, I can’t help but think that Brian Kemp has
the same mentality as my English teacher — that the only folks who get the
chance to grow are those who look, sound and speak like them.

Derek, this
story is why I believe in One Georgia: we all deserve the chance to grow
and thrive, not just some of us. And I believe we all should speak up, and
use all the tools and words at our disposal to make ourselves heard.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221014_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=12556%2E1862389%2EnGFdMG ]And it is why I am humbly asking, Derek:
with just 3 days left until early
voting begins, will you help me build a Georgia where everyone thrives?
Chip in to power my campaign today.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4766?refcode=sa_em_221014_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open_RS&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=12556%2E1862389%2EnGFdMG ]DONATE

# **Josh Harder Does Not Deny Taking AOC Money, Taking Defund Police Pledge**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - Josh Harder and San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti took questions from the _Stockton Record_ and _Modesto Bee_ yesterday. When the subject of law enforcement came up, Harder said, “We need more cops on the streets.” But it appears this was a very careful parsing of words. He did not state that we need more law enforcement.

Perhaps that is because the truth is Harder has pledged to vote for “A public safety strategy to reduce the annual budget for law enforcement.” We know this because he accepted money from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s “Courage to Change” political action committee. (See [AOC showers dozens of vulnerable House Dems with campaign cash | Fox News](https://tompattiforcongress.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35b3ff69952b238846e5a10cc&id=9761cac7ea&e=5d7a2268d7).)

This PAC requires those who accept funds to say yes to the following pledge, "If running for a legislative position . . . do you pledge to vote for the following: A public safety strategy to reduce the annual budget for law enforcement and defense spending, and shift those funds towards community resources and programs... .” ([AOC PAC makes pledge to slash police, defense spending a litmus test for candidates seeking support | Fox News](https://tompattiforcongress.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=35b3ff69952b238846e5a10cc&id=a3444ee9db&e=5d7a2268d7).)

In the meeting yesterday, Supervisor Patti called out Harder on this, asserting that Harder received $5,000 from her PAC which “supports defunding police” and asked that Harder return the money. When given the opportunity to respond to Patti’s assertion, Harder did not deny receiving the money or making the pledge. Instead, he simply stated, “If you want to run against AOC feel free to move to New York to do so.” (Audio recording of the exchange available upon request.)

Supervisor Patti is endorsed by the Stockton Police Officers Association, San Joaquin Deputy Sheriffs Association, San Joaquin Correctional Officers Association, and the Stockton Professional Firefighters Association.
---

| **About Supervisor Tom Patti:** Tom was raised in San Joaquin County and has run a successful local business for decades. He was elected to the San Joaquin County Board of Supervisors in 2016 by an overwhelming margin.

As a County Supervisor, community volunteer, and parent, Tom has worked and dedicated his efforts to safer neighborhoods, demanded real action to reduce homelessness, and advocated for improving the quality, accessibility, and availability of local healthcare.

Tom Patti has worked hard to support veterans, improve and fund our community colleges, support our farmers, advanced workforce equity and created many new job opportunities.

Dear Friend,

Congressman Costa is attacking me on TV, and he is running scared.

And for a good reason.

We just received [polling results](https://michaelmaher.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6239b7d9cb3ad9388556be8be&id=29b99ae60a&e=1722d05e10) from the respected independent pollster company, Trafalgar. They show my race is TIED!

I think I know why.

Inflation is running rampant, affecting every single one of us, and crime is up. Meanwhile, Congressman Jim Costa has voted to RAISE Taxes, INCREASE our cost of living, and WEAKEN public safety.

No wonder Americans of all parties think things are going in the wrong direction.

So it's no surprise that, after three decades in Congress, Jim Costa is panicking. He started airing TV ads this week attacking me.

Jim Costa knows he's in trouble. He knows his voting record is hurting him with voters.

But Jim Costa does have one thing—money. That is why I am writing to you today. Will you help me with a contribution so that my campaign can compete, persuade voters that I can help get this country on the right track, and get out our vote?

Peter, in 1994 I was painfully outed as gay by my homophobic Republican opponent, Ken Calvert. _I lost that election and Calvert is still in Congress._

Folks – Herschel Walker and I wrapped up our first and only scheduled debate before Election Day.

I was thrilled to share my pro-Georgia record and show the voters just how different Walker and I are, but we have a problem: With experts at FiveThirtyEight saying that our race will determine Senate control, national Republicans have outspent us on the airwaves and poured more than $30 million into Walker’s campaign to defeat me.

That’s why we set a goal to raise $100,000 before midnight tonight to make sure we have enough critical resources to fight back against GOP spending and win this race – but at this make-or-break moment, we’re falling incredibly short.

We’re in the most important stretch of this entire campaign, folks. And if we don’t close this gap in time, we could put this seat, our entire Senate majority, and all of the progress we’ve made in jeopardy.

Unlike Walker, I refuse to take a cent from corporate PACs. From the very start, I’ve relied entirely on grassroots folks like you to power us to victory – so I have to urgently ask you in this important moment: Before the midnight deadline, will you split a donation between Democratic Association of Secretaries of State and me to help hit our fundraising goal, win in Georgia, and keep the Senate blue?

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

I gave it everything I had during last night's debate against Ron Johnson. Now early voting begins on October 25. That means our chance to reach persuadable voters is rapidly decreasing with each day that passes.
I'm going to keep working as hard as I possibly can between now and Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.
Wisconsin was always going to be one of the most competitive and most expensive Senate races in the entire country. But I wasn't expecting us to be outspent 2 to 1 by Republicans, and their significant spending advantage could mean trouble for our chances to win.
**Ron Johnson and his dark-money groups are using fear and deception to try to defend this seat, and we urgently need to set the record straight. Otherwise, we risk losing this race and Republicans regaining the Senate majority.**

After a strong legislative session for climate and environmental action, Connecticut LCV released its... Lift note:

After a strong legislative session for climate and environmental action, Connecticut LCV released its 2022 Environmental Scorecard https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/L6b_ breaking down what happened in the state General Assembly this year. This is a great resource to learn more about important bills, opportunities for next year and where your legislators stand on the issues. Check it out and read more below from our friends at CTLCV!

For Immediate Release: Aug 4, 2022

Contact:
Lori.brown@ctlcv.org 860-214-0345
Azya@ctlcv.org 860-420-7700

CTLCV RELEASES 2022 ENVIRONMENTAL SCORECARD

The Connecticut League of Conservation Voters (CTLCV) released the 2022 Environmental Scorecard, https://links.messages.lcv. a comprehensive review of the major environmental victories, challenges and losses in the Connecticut General Assembly during the 2022 legislative session. It also grades state legislators on their votes cast for or against environmental bills.

Important victories this year included committing to transition Connecticut to 100% zero-carbon electricity by 2040 and passing the Connecticut Clean Air Act which will reduce harmful emissions pollution from transportation.

"The 2022 session was a major year for environmental policy in Connecticut, which included passage of five major bills to tackle climate change and directly improve air quality," said Lori Brown, Executive Director of CTLCV. "Many lawmakers created real change in environmental policy, and we want to thank all of our environmental champions for their work. However, there are still lawmakers who rank poorly, and we hope they will try to improve their scores next year." The Scorecard https://links.messages.lcv. highlights "Environmental Champions" - legislators who scored high and led pro-environment initiatives - as well as those who are "Out of Sync" with environmental values and scored poorly.

"Voters need to know how their elected leaders vote on environmental issues. Either they are leading the way, or they are getting in the way," said Brown.

CTLCV scored lawmakers' votes on twenty bills covering issues such as climate, wildlife, clean water, pesticides, land conservation, and more.

As always, some bills did not make it over the finish line and the Scorecard https://links.messages.lcv. lists the "Unfinished Business" that CTLCV expects to see re-introduced in 2023.

"Considering the difficulties at the federal level in passing environmental laws-and that EPA's enforcement abilities have been severely weakened-it's more important now than ever that we elect pro-environment lawmakers at the state legislative level and hold everyone accountable," said Brown

The CT League of Conservation Voters (CTLCV) is a nonpartisan statewide organization dedicated to protecting Connecticut's environment. CTLCV works to pass equitable and sustainable legislation that impacts our air, land, water, wildlife, and climate and holds all state legislators accountable with an annual Environmental Scorecard. Visit ctlcv.org for more information on CTLCV.

| | | | | _Note from Cliff: A Legend is visiting Blue Amp Action with a crucial ask of us all._ _Peter_ _ - _ We’re at a turning point in our country. Even though Democrats have a thin majority, Republicans are using the filibuster to block important bills in the Senate. **50/50 is not enough. It’s clear we must expand the Democratic Senate majority to abolish the filibuster and make the real progress American people want. I believe Tim Ryan is our opportunity to do just that.** **[Will you join me in supporting his campaign? Please, make a donation of whatever you can afford to Tim and BlueAmp Action help us flip Ohio blue. Anything you give would mean a lot to me personally.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc5fbcf63-0e8d-4ebf-8389-b0e5ab0ed334/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** I was born and raised in Springfield, Ohio. That’s actually how I got my start in music—performing in my church choir. I will always have a special place in my heart for the Buckeye State. Ohio’s U.S. Senate race in November is one of the most important fights of our lifetime, which is why I couldn’t just sit on the sidelines. **And you can’t either**

| National Republicans and their billionaire backers are already spending upwards of**$80 MILLION** to keep Ohio red and ensure Mitch McConnell retakes total control of the Senate. If that happens, Peter, voting rights, a higher minimum wage, affordable health care, high-quality education for all our kids, and more are in jeopardy. I don’t want to think about the damage that Republicans could do if they regain their grip on our government. **But the good news is if we win Ohio, Democrats can hold and expand our Senate majority. Even better news? Tim is neck-and-neck with JD Vance in the polls.** **[We CAN win, Peter, but only if you help Tim fight back against the attacks heading his way. Can I personally count on you to add a donation now to help Tim’s campaign and BlueAmp Action win this important race?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8ac2f046-7303-43bc-ac70-d9316631aa6c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Tim Ryan is the leader Ohio deserves. He will do whatever it takes to make sure working families get the support they need. That’s why we’re both counting on your help to win. Thank you. I know how much this team means to Tim and it’s incredible to see so many supporters join this fight alongside us. —John Legend

Friend, I was incredibly pleased last week by President Biden's announcement that he'll pardon anyone who was federally convicted of marijuana possession. I'm hopeful that this will put us on the path to decriminalization at the federal level.

Criminalizing marijuana perpetuates racial inequities in our justice system (Black Americans are nearly four times more likely than white Americans to be arrested for marijuana possession), and it takes up valuable time and resources that should be used for tackling the violent crimes that actually pose a threat to our communities. **I was proud when Virginia legalized marijuana last year, and I'll continue to advocate to make this change happen at the federal level.**

But my opponent sees it differently. In our most recent debate, he said that he supports the unequal and unsustainable status quo that keeps marijuana possession as a federal crime.

Northern Virginians deserve a representative who's serious about making our criminal justice system more efficient. clean_body: = Friend, I was incredibly pleased last week by President Biden's announcement that he'll pardon anyone who was federally convicted of marijuana possession. I'm hopeful that this will put us on the path to decriminalization at the federal level. Criminalizing marijuana perpetuates racial inequities in our justice system (Black Americans are nearly four times more likely than white Americans to be arrested for marijuana possession), and it takes up valuable time and resources that should be used for tackling the violent crimes that actually pose a threat to our communities. I was proud when Virginia legalized marijuana last year, and I'll continue to advocate to make this change happen at the federal level. But my opponent sees it differently. In our most recent debate, he said that he supports the unequal and unsustainable status quo that keeps marijuana possession as a federal crime. Northern Virginians deserve a representative who's serious about making our criminal justice system more efficient. They deserve a leader who's willing to take on the gun lobby to address violent crime.
